WITH eligible_winners AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id, NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), '') AS hand
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM eligible_winners
    GROUP BY hand
)
SELECT hand, winner_count,
       1.0 * winner_count / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts
ORDER BY hand;

WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
         COUNT(*) AS award_record_count
  FROM manager_award AS ma
  JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       award_record_count,
       1.0 * award_record_count / SUM(award_record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts;

WITH color_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_color,
    SUM(COALESCE(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS invoiced_amount
  FROM Products AS p
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
),
color_shares AS (
  SELECT
    product_color,
    invoiced_amount,
    invoiced_amount / NULLIF(SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total
  FROM color_amounts
),
summary AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_per_color
  FROM color_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(cs.invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount,
  AVG(cs.share_of_total) AS average_share,
  AVG(cs.invoiced_amount - s.average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average
FROM color_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN summary AS s
WHERE cs.invoiced_amount > s.average_per_color;

WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantity
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
), color_metrics AS (
  SELECT product_color, quantity,
         CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL) / SUM(quantity) OVER () AS share,
         AVG(quantity) OVER () AS average_quantity
  FROM color_totals
), above_average AS (
  SELECT quantity, share, quantity - average_quantity AS excess
  FROM color_metrics
  WHERE quantity > average_quantity
)
SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess) AS average_excess_quantity
FROM above_average;

WITH rental_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), above_average_rentals AS (
  SELECT rental_id, store_id, payment_total,
         AVG(payment_total) OVER () AS average_payment_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals
)
SELECT store_id,
       SUM(payment_total) AS combined_payment_total,
       AVG(payment_total - average_payment_total) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average_rentals
WHERE payment_total > average_payment_total
GROUP BY store_id;

WITH rental_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals
), qualifying_rentals AS (
  SELECT rpt.store_id, rpt.payment_total, oa.avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals rpt
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE rpt.payment_total > oa.avg_payment_total
)
SELECT store_id,
       SUM(payment_total) AS qualifying_rentals_payment_total,
       AVG(payment_total - avg_payment_total) AS avg_excess_overall_average
FROM qualifying_rentals
GROUP BY store_id;

WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_invoiced_quantity,
    AVG(
      (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)
      / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)
    ) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_invoiced_quantity,
    avg_cost_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color
      ORDER BY avg_invoiced_quantity DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_invoiced_quantity,
  avg_cost_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        il.order_item_id,
        p.product_color,
        AVG(CAST(il.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(38, 10))) AS avg_invoiced_quantity,
        AVG(
            (il.derived_product_cost - il.derived_total_cost)
            / NULLIF(il.derived_total_cost, 0)
        ) AS avg_cost_difference_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS il
    INNER JOIN Order_Items AS oi
        ON oi.order_item_id = il.order_item_id
    INNER JOIN Products AS p
        ON p.product_id = il.product_id
    GROUP BY il.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked_groups AS (
    SELECT
        order_item_id,
        product_color,
        avg_invoiced_quantity,
        avg_cost_difference_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_color
            ORDER BY avg_invoiced_quantity DESC
        ) AS quantity_rank
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_invoiced_quantity,
    avg_cost_difference_ratio,
    quantity_rank
FROM ranked_groups
WHERE quantity_rank <= 3;

WITH region_stats AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
           AVG(t.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), above_average AS (
    SELECT region, avg_transaction_amount, transaction_count,
           avg_transaction_amount - AVG(avg_transaction_amount) OVER () AS amount_above_cross_region_avg
    FROM region_stats
    WHERE avg_transaction_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_transaction_amount) FROM region_stats)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_transaction_amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
       AVG(transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count,
       AVG(amount_above_cross_region_avg) AS average_amount_above_cross_region_average
FROM above_average;

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) AS plain_avg_daily_price_across_ratings FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_replacement_cost, ra.avg_rental_price_per_day, ra.avg_rental_price_per_day / o.plain_avg_daily_price_across_ratings AS ratio_to_plain_avg_across_ratings FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY ra.rating

WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS album_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) AS rate
  FROM album_stats
  WHERE album_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(a.album_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(CAST(a.track_count AS REAL)) AS average_track_count,
  AVG(a.album_rate - m.rate) AS average_amount_above_mean
FROM album_stats AS a
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m
WHERE a.album_rate > m.rate;

WITH album_rates AS (
    SELECT
        AlbumId,
        AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(ar.rate) AS average_rate,
    AVG(ar.track_count) AS average_track_count,
    AVG(ar.rate - mr.rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr
WHERE ar.rate > mr.rate;

WITH per_event_name AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_name
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS mean_of_averages
    FROM per_event_name
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.average_budgeted_amount,
       p.average_budgeted_amount - o.mean_of_averages AS above_mean,
       p.average_budgeted_amount / o.mean_of_averages AS ratio_to_mean
FROM per_event_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.average_budgeted_amount > o.mean_of_averages;

WITH event_name_averages AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_name
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM event_name_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT a.event_name, a.avg_amount, o.overall_avg
    FROM event_name_averages AS a
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
), kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_kept
    FROM kept
)
SELECT k.event_name,
       k.avg_amount,
       k.avg_amount - k.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall_average,
       k.avg_amount / ka.avg_kept AS ratio_to_kept_average
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka;

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        AVG(1.0 * spent / amount) AS spend_ratio
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS overall_average
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT
    event_ratios.event_id,
    event_ratios.spend_ratio,
    event_ratios.spend_ratio / overall.overall_average AS relative_spend_ratio
FROM event_ratios
CROSS JOIN overall
ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY BillingState
), state_metrics AS (
  SELECT invoice_count,
         1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS invoice_share,
         AVG(1.0 * invoice_count) OVER () AS avg_state_count
  FROM state_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT invoice_count, invoice_share, avg_state_count
  FROM state_metrics
  WHERE invoice_count > avg_state_count
)
SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(invoice_count - avg_state_count) AS average_invoices_above_average
FROM above_average;

WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoice
    WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY BillingState
), metrics AS (
    SELECT invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS invoice_share,
           AVG(1.0 * invoice_count) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_count), 0) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(invoice_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM metrics
WHERE invoice_count > average_count;

WITH invoice_prices AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        i.CustomerId,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.CustomerId
),
invoice_deviations AS (
    SELECT
        ip.InvoiceId,
        c.Country,
        ip.average_unit_price,
        ip.average_unit_price - AVG(ip.average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation_from_overall_average
    FROM invoice_prices AS ip
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = ip.CustomerId
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        Country,
        average_unit_price,
        deviation_from_overall_average,
        deviation_from_overall_average - AVG(deviation_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY Country)
            AS deviation_minus_country_average_deviation
    FROM invoice_deviations
)
SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    average_unit_price AS average_unit_price,
    deviation_from_overall_average,
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation
FROM scored
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN deviation_minus_country_average_deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM status_counts
  WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_counts)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_pct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
  AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM status_shares
WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;

WITH gender_counts AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoiced_order_count
    FROM Invoices AS i
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
), shares AS (
    SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count,
           1.0 * invoiced_order_count / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM gender_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share,
           share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, share, above_average
FROM scored
WHERE above_average > 0

WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
), shares AS (
  SELECT gender, invoice_count,
         1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM gender_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT gender, invoice_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT gender, invoice_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse_rate,
         a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_over_first_mean
  FROM status_averages AS a
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT k.avg_pulse_rate,
         k.excess_over_first_mean,
         k.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_over_second_mean
  FROM first_kept AS k
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
  WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate_of_final_statuses,
       AVG(excess_over_first_mean) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_over_second_mean) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM final_kept;

WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT
    t.telescregistry,
    t.equipstatus,
    AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN signals AS s
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescope_averages
  GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS value
  FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate,
         sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.value AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.value
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS value
  FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_first,
         fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.value AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS fk
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.value
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

WITH account_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                 WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
                 ELSE NULL END) AS account_total,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(account_total) AS region_total
    FROM account_totals
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    at.account_id,
    at.region,

WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o.timespan,
         AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
with_cross_group_avg AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(match_count) OVER () AS cross_group_avg
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_group_average_ratios,
       SUM(match_count) AS total_match_count,
       AVG(match_count - cross_group_avg) AS average_excess_match_count
FROM with_cross_group_avg
WHERE match_count > cross_group_avg;

WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
cross_group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_fee_count
  FROM group_stats
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT g.avg_ratio, g.fee_count, a.avg_fee_count
  FROM group_stats AS g
  CROSS JOIN cross_group_avg AS a
  WHERE g.fee_count > a.avg_fee_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_group_average_ratios,
  SUM(fee_count) AS total_fee_records,
  AVG(fee_count - avg_fee_count) AS average_excess_fee_count
FROM kept_groups;

WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins
), above_group AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM above_overall
), selected AS (
  SELECT ao.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN above_group ag
  WHERE ao.avg_wins > ag.avg_wins
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average_wins,
       AVG(s.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall_average,
       AVG(s.avg_wins - ag.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_group_average
FROM selected s
CROSS JOIN overall o
CROSS JOIN above_group ag;

WITH per_race_gains AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    cs.constructorId,
    r.year,
    r.round,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(
      LAG(cs.wins) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
        ORDER BY r.round
      ),
      0
    ) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins
  FROM per_race_gains
  GROUP BY country
),
all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_all
  FROM country_averages
),
above_all AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, am.mean_all
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.mean_all
),
above_all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_above_all
  FROM above_all
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_wins, aa.mean_all, aam.mean_above_all
  FROM above_all AS aa
  CROSS JOIN above_all_mean AS aam
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > aam.mean_above_all
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_final_average_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - mean_all) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean,
  AVG(avg_wins - mean_above_all) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean
FROM final_countries;

WITH rep_counts AS (

  FROM Employee e
  JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId

rep_stats AS (

),
selected_reps AS (

  FROM rep_stats
  WHERE customer_count > city_avg
),

SELECT s.City AS city,

       AVG(1.0 * s.customer_count / NULLIF(o.customer_count, 0)) AS average_share_of_overall_customers
FROM selected_reps s
CROSS JOIN overall o
GROUP BY s.City;

WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg,
    t.ordertypedist,
    AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
order_type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_short_interest_days_to_cover) AS order_type_avg_short_interest
  FROM transaction_averages
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ta.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  ta.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  ta.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ta.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / NULLIF(ota.order_type_avg_short_interest, 0)
    AS short_interest_to_order_type_average_ratio
FROM transaction_averages AS ta
JOIN order_type_averages AS ota
  ON ota.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ta.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_to_order_type_average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH spend_by_budget AS (
    SELECT
        b.budget_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_spend,
        COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e
        ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_spend) AS average_spend_per_budget_line
    FROM spend_by_budget
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT s.total_spend, s.expense_count, a.average_spend_per_budget_line
    FROM spend_by_budget AS s
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE s.total_spend > a.average_spend_per_budget_line
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_spend) AS average_total_spend,
    SUM(expense_count) AS total_expense_count,
    AVG(total_spend - average_spend_per_budget_line) AS average_excess_over_average
FROM above_average;

WITH per_line AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_budget,
        SUM(cost) AS total_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS expense_count
    FROM expense
    WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
average_total AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total_cost
    FROM per_line
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT p.total_cost, p.expense_count, a.avg_total_cost
    FROM per_line AS p
    CROSS JOIN average_total AS a
    WHERE p.total_cost > a.avg_total_cost
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_cost) AS average_total,
    SUM(expense_count) AS total_expense_count,
    AVG(total_cost - avg_total_cost) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_track_unit_price, AVG(UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId

WITH media_type_averages AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS baseline_avg_price
  FROM media_type_averages
)
SELECT m.MediaTypeId,
       m.avg_unit_price,
       m.avg_unit_price / b.baseline_avg_price AS ratio_to_baseline
FROM media_type_averages AS m
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.avg_unit_price / b.baseline_avg_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         ratio_to_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
        COUNT(*) AS fielding_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        batting_hand,
        fielding_count,
        1.0 * fielding_count / SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
        AVG(fielding_count) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT
    batting_hand,
    fielding_count,
    share_of_total,
    fielding_count - average_count AS above_average
FROM summary
WHERE fielding_count > average_count
ORDER BY batting_hand;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count, AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.bats, h.record_count, 1.0 * h.record_count / t.total_count AS share, h.record_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.record_count > t.average_count

WITH city_address_counts AS (
  SELECT ci.city_id, COUNT(a.address_id) AS address_count
  FROM city AS ci
  LEFT JOIN address AS a ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
  GROUP BY ci.city_id
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(address_count) AS all_addresses,
         AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses_per_city
  FROM city_address_counts
)
SELECT cac.city_id,
       cac.address_count,
       cac.address_count / t.avg_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average,
       cac.address_count / t.all_addresses AS share_of_all_addresses
FROM city_address_counts AS cac
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
), city_stats AS (
  SELECT
    city_id,
    address_count,
    AVG(address_count) OVER () AS avg_addresses_per_city,
    SUM(address_count) OVER () AS total_addresses
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT
  city_id,
  address_count,
  address_count / avg_addresses_per_city AS count_over_city_average,
  address_count / total_addresses AS share_of_addresses
FROM city_stats
ORDER BY share_of_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.MediaTypeId,
        mt.Name AS MediaTypeName,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS Rate
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
    MediaTypeName,
    Rate,
    Rate - AVG(Rate) OVER () AS AmountAboveAverage
FROM media_type_rates
WHERE Rate > AVG(Rate) OVER ();

WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_average
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
  r.media_type_name,
  r.byte_rate,
  r.byte_rate - o.overall_average AS above_overall_average
FROM media_type_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE r.byte_rate > o.overall_average;

WITH telescope_counts AS (

    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation

),
shares AS (
  SELECT

         SUM(results.points) AS total_points,
         AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
), threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total_points
  FROM per_race_name
), kept AS (
  SELECT p.total_points, p.average_laps, t.average_total_points
  FROM per_race_name AS p
  CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
  WHERE p.total_points > t.average_total_points
)
SELECT SUM(total_points) AS sum_total_points,
       AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_race_name_average_laps,
       AVG(total_points - average_total_points) AS average_excess_points

WITH account_flows AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS net_flow,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    region,
    net_flow,
    transaction_count,
    net_flow * 1.0 / SUM(net_flow) OVER () AS share_of_total_net_flow
FROM account_flows
ORDER BY share_of_total_net_flow DESC
LIMIT 10

        account_count,
        1.0 * account_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share
    FROM district_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        account_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT district_id, account_count, share, difference_from_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference FROM shares) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, difference FROM ranked ORDER BY difference DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM account_order_counts
), differences AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        order_count - avg_order_count AS difference_from_overall_average
    FROM account_order_counts
    CROSS JOIN overall_average
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) AS avg_difference
    FROM differences
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    d.account_id,
    d.region,
    d.order_count,
    d.difference_from_overall_average,
    d.difference_from_overall_average - r.avg_difference AS excess_over_region_average
FROM differences AS d
JOIN region_averages AS r ON r.region = d.region
WHERE d.difference_from_overall_average > r.avg_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e
      ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_averages AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM event_averages
    GROUP BY status
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT
    s.status,
    s.avg_remaining,
    s.avg_overspend_rate,
    s.avg_remaining / NULLIF(o.avg_remaining, 0) AS avg_remaining_ratio_to_overall
FROM status_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o;

WITH event_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM event_metrics
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT
    status,
    avg_remaining,
    avg_overspend_rate,
    avg_remaining / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining) OVER (), 0) AS remaining_vs_status_mean
FROM status_metrics;

WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.type,
        AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type
),
type_rates AS (
    SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates
    GROUP BY type
)
SELECT
    type,
    average_spending_rate,
    average_spending_rate / NULLIF(AVG(average_spending_rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_vs_simple_mean
FROM type_rates;

WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spending_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
), type_rates AS (
    SELECT e.type, AVG(er.avg_spending_rate) AS avg_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates AS er
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = er.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, avg_spending_rate,
       avg_spending_rate / NULLIF(AVG(avg_spending_rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_divided_by_mean
FROM type_rates;

WITH by_trader_type AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS analysed_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    analysed_count,
    analysed_count::numeric / SUM(analysed_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM by_trader_type
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(analysed_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(analysed_count) AS combined_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(analysed_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM above_average
WHERE analysed_count > average_count;

WITH per_type AS (
    SELECT
        t.tradekind,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS transaction_count
    FROM advancedbehavior AS a
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
      ON tr.transreg = a.translink
    JOIN trader AS t
      ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY t.tradekind
), metrics AS (
    SELECT
        tradekind,
        transaction_count,
        transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share,
        AVG(transaction_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM per_type
)
SELECT
    SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_counts,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM metrics
WHERE transaction_count > average_count

WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        average_transaction_amount,
        transaction_count,
        transaction_count * 1.0 / AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS ratio
    FROM account_stats
)
SELECT account_id, average_transaction_amount, transaction_count, ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH account_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    avg_signed_amount,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM account_totals) AS transaction_count_ratio
FROM account_totals
ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH matched_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, e.fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
), channel_counts AS (
  SELECT orderbase, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM matched_executions
  GROUP BY orderbase
)
SELECT
  c.orderbase AS channel,
  AVG(m.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity,
  c.execution_count AS count,
  c.execution_count::numeric / SUM(c.execution_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM channel_counts AS c
JOIN matched_executions AS m
  ON m.orderbase IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.orderbase
GROUP BY c.orderbase, c.execution_count
ORDER BY c.orderbase NULLS FIRST;

SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS execution_fraction FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase ORDER BY o.orderbase NULLS FIRST

WITH per_id AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_of_id_averages
    FROM per_id
)
SELECT p.ID,
       p.avg_ana,
       p.avg_ana - o.mean_of_id_averages AS gap_above_mean
FROM per_id AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_of_id_averages
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS average_ana
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_ana) AS mean_of_group_averages
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT g.ID,
       g.average_ana,
       g.average_ana - m.mean_of_group_averages AS excess
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE g.average_ana > m.mean_of_group_averages
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH patient_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_examinations,
           COUNT(*) AS patient_count
    FROM patient_counts
), shares AS (
    SELECT pc.ID,
           pc.examination_count,
           1.0 * pc.examination_count / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total,
           1.0 / t.patient_count AS average_share
    FROM patient_counts AS pc
    CROSS JOIN totals AS t
)
SELECT ID,
       examination_count,
       share_of_total,
       share_of_total - average_share AS margin_above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share_of_total > average_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), fractions AS (
    SELECT ID,
           examination_count,
           1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction
    FROM patient_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID,
           examination_count,
           fraction,
           fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () AS excess
    FROM fractions
)
SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, excess
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH matched_fee_rates AS (
  SELECT
    o.mktnote,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched_fee_rates
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS pair_avg
  FROM matched_fee_rates
  GROUP BY mktnote
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - g.overall_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS g
  WHERE g.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND p.pair_avg > g.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS mean_pair_average_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_overall_average
FROM qualifying;

WITH per_pair AS (
  SELECT
    o.mktnote,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  GROUP BY o.mktnote
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM per_pair
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.benchmark_rate
  FROM per_pair AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE b.benchmark_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH channel_rates AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), above_average AS (
  SELECT orderbase, avg_feerate
  FROM channel_rates
  WHERE avg_feerate > (SELECT AVG(feerate) FROM fees WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_average_fee_rate,
       AVG(avg_feerate - (SELECT AVG(feerate) FROM fees WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3
), totals AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, client_count,
           SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_total,
           SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_total
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district_id, region, client_count,
       1.0 * client_count / region_total AS fraction_of_region,
       1.0 * client_count / overall_total AS fraction_overall
FROM totals
ORDER BY fraction_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM disp AS dp
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

),
shares AS (

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rented_films
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), shares AS (
  SELECT rating, rented_films,
         rented_films * 1.0 / SUM(rented_films) OVER () AS share
  FROM rating_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.rented_films) AS combined_rented_films,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_above_average_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.share > a.value;

WITH rating_film_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, film_count, film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_film_counts), above_average AS (SELECT rating, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average WHERE share > average_share

WITH player_counts AS (

    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), above_average AS (
    SELECT death_state, hof_count,
           AVG(hof_count) OVER () AS state_average
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(hof_count - state_average) AS average_amount_above
FROM above_average
WHERE hof_count > state_average;

WITH patient_averages AS (

    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg_hgb

    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
), above_overall AS (

           avg_hgb - overall_avg_hgb AS above_overall_by,

WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
), overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb

), kept AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.avg_hgb AS overall_avg

), scored AS (

WITH scopes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT acctscope
  FROM users
),
matched_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.acctscope, o.recordvault
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
),
counts AS (
  SELECT s.acctscope, COUNT(m.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM scopes AS s
  LEFT JOIN matched_orders AS m ON m.acctscope IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.acctscope
  GROUP BY s.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope,
       order_count,
       order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total,
       order_count::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS divided_by_average
FROM counts
ORDER BY acctscope;

  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope AS scope,
       risk_margin_count,
       risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       risk_margin_count::numeric / AVG(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS divided_by_scope_average
FROM scope_counts;

    FROM order_counts

)
SELECT account_id,
       order_count,
       above_overall_average,
       order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS above_above_average_accounts_average
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_above_average_accounts_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM order_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_order_count
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_order_count
), kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.account_id,
       aa.order_count,
       aa.order_count - aa.avg_order_count AS above_overall_average,
       aa.order_count - ka.avg_order_count AS above_kept_average
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC, aa.account_id
LIMIT 10

WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally,
         tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share,
         1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_tallies
)
SELECT archstat AS status,
       tally,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share;

  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT archstat, record_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT COALESCE(archstat, '(missing)') AS archstat,
       record_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM with_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH matched_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, e.fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
), status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    orderflow,
    AVG(fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM matched_executions
  GROUP BY orderflow
)
SELECT
  orderflow AS status,
  average_filled_quantity,
  execution_count,
  execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions
FROM status_counts;

WITH matched_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, e.fillcount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
), status_counts AS (
  SELECT orderflow,
         AVG(fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity,
         COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM matched_executions
  GROUP BY orderflow
)
SELECT orderflow,
       average_filled_quantity,
       execution_count,
       execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions
FROM status_counts;

WITH member_totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM income
    GROUP BY link_to_member
), shares AS (
    SELECT total_amount,
           1.0 * total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS share
    FROM member_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT total_amount, share
    FROM shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS combined_amount,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

WITH member_income AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount
    FROM income
    WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_member
), shares AS (
    SELECT member_amount * 1.0 / SUM(member_amount) OVER () AS share
    FROM member_income
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
), above_average AS (
    SELECT share
    FROM shares
    CROSS JOIN average_share
    WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT
    SUM(member_amount) AS total_summed_amount,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM (
    SELECT member_amount, share, avg_share
    FROM member_income
    CROSS JOIN average_share
    WHERE member_amount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_amount) FROM member_income) > avg_share
) AS qualifying_groups

WITH per_frequency AS (
    SELECT a.frequency,
           AVG(CASE t.type
                   WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN 1.0 * t.amount
                   WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -1.0 * t.amount
               END) AS avg_signed_amount,
           AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY a.frequency
),
mean_signed_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS value
    FROM per_frequency
),
above_mean AS (
    SELECT p.avg_signed_amount, p.avg_balance, m.value AS mean_value
    FROM per_frequency AS p
    CROSS JOIN mean_signed_average AS m
    WHERE p.avg_signed_amount > m.value
)
SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_average,
       AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance_average,
       AVG(avg_signed_amount - mean_value) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM above_mean;

WITH per_frequency AS (
    SELECT
        a.frequency,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount
                ELSE NULL
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.frequency
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount
    FROM per_frequency
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_of_above_mean_signed_amounts,
    AVG(p.avg_balance) AS avg_balance_for_above_mean_frequencies,
    AVG(p.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM per_frequency AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_amount

WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM order_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_unfilled,
         oa.avg_unfilled - o.avg_unfilled AS excess_over_overall
  FROM order_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE oa.avg_unfilled > o.avg_unfilled
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM above_overall
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT ao.avg_unfilled,
         ao.excess_over_overall,
         ao.avg_unfilled - ga.avg_unfilled AS excess_over_group
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN group_average ga
  WHERE ao.avg_unfilled > ga.avg_unfilled
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS average_of_qualifying_orders,
       AVG(excess_over_overall) AS average_excess_over_overall,
       AVG(excess_over_group) AS average_excess_over_group
FROM qualifying;

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remaincount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_excess AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_remaincount,
         p.avg_remaincount - b.benchmark AS excess_first
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_remaincount > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS benchmark
  FROM first_excess
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT f.avg_remaincount, f.excess_first,
         f.avg_remaincount - b.benchmark AS excess_second
  FROM first_excess f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE f.avg_remaincount > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS remaining_orders_avg,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders;

WITH district_account_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
)
SELECT district_id,
       account_count,
       CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share_of_all_accounts
FROM district_account_counts
ORDER BY share_of_all_accounts DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
), shares AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         account_count,
         1.0 * account_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share
  FROM district_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT district_id, account_count, share,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT district_id, account_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC;

WITH telescope_shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
         COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
summary AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM telescope_shares
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS combined_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM summary
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;
SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share_of_total FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY share_of_total DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members
    FROM member_counts
)
SELECT mc.major_id,
       mc.member_count,
       CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / t.total_members AS fraction_of_members
FROM member_counts AS mc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY fraction_of_members DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(1.0 * HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
cross_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
selected_patients AS (
    SELECT pr.ID, pr.avg_ratio, cpa.avg_ratio AS cross_avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios pr
    CROSS JOIN cross_patient_average cpa
    WHERE pr.avg_ratio > cpa.avg_ratio
),
patient_pic AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(1.0 * PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PIC IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(pp.avg_pic) AS mean_of_patient_average_pic,
    AVG(sp.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(sp.avg_ratio - sp.cross_avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_over_cross_patient_average
FROM selected_patients sp
LEFT JOIN patient_pic pp ON pp.ID = sp.ID;

WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
all_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
    WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    AVG(ps.avg_pic) AS avg_of_patient_avg_pic,
    AVG(ps.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(ps.ratio - apa.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM patient_stats AS ps
CROSS JOIN all_patient_average AS apa
WHERE ps.ratio > apa.avg_ratio;

SELECT

FROM player_college AS pc
JOIN college AS c
  ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
GROUP BY c.state;

WITH matched_records AS (
    SELECT c.state
    FROM player_college AS pc
    INNER JOIN college AS c
        ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
), state_counts AS (
    SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS matched_count
    FROM matched_records
    GROUP BY state
)
SELECT
    state,
    matched_count,
    1.0 * matched_count / SUM(matched_count) OVER () AS share
FROM state_counts;

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg
  FROM compliancecase
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT sa.brokrepstat, sa.avg_modelconf, r.overall_avg
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN reference r
  WHERE sa.avg_modelconf IS NOT NULL
    AND r.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.avg_modelconf > r.overall_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
  q.brokrepstat AS status,
  q.avg_modelconf AS average_model_confidence,
  q.avg_modelconf - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by,
  q.avg_modelconf / NULLIF(qm.mean_qualifying_avg, 0) AS ratio_to_mean_qualifying_average
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
WHERE qm.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND qm.mean_qualifying_avg <> 0;

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline_avg
  FROM status_averages
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT sa.brokrepstat, sa.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg
), qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.brokrepstat AS status,
       q.avg_modelconf AS average_model_confidence,
       q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS above_baseline,
       q.avg_modelconf / qm.mean_qualifying_avg AS fraction_of_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND qm.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL;

WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.MediaTypeId,
        AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
), cross_media_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(mr.avg_unit_price) AS average_of_average_unit_prices,
    AVG(mr.bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    AVG(mr.bytes_per_millisecond - ca.avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate_above_cross_media_average
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN cross_media_average AS ca
WHERE mr.bytes_per_millisecond > ca.avg_bytes_per_millisecond;

WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
rate_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS cross_media_type_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT m.avg_unit_price, m.byte_rate, b.cross_media_type_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates AS m
  CROSS JOIN rate_baseline AS b
  WHERE m.byte_rate > b.cross_media_type_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_of_media_type_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate,
  AVG(byte_rate - cross_media_type_avg_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate
FROM above_average;

WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
  Name,
  bytes_per_millisecond,
  bytes_per_millisecond / AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM media_rates;

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.MediaTypeId,
        mt.Name,
        SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
    FROM Track AS t
    INNER JOIN MediaType AS mt
        ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
    Name,
    rate,
    rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS rate_over_mean
FROM media_type_rates;

WITH film_actor_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
), first_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actor_count
  FROM film_actor_counts
), above_first AS (
  SELECT c.film_id, c.actor_count, c.actor_count - a.avg_actor_count AS excess_first
  FROM film_actor_counts AS c
  CROSS JOIN first_average AS a
  WHERE a.avg_actor_count IS NOT NULL
    AND c.actor_count > a.avg_actor_count
), second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actor_count
  FROM above_first
), above_second AS (
  SELECT c.actor_count, c.excess_first,
         c.actor_count - a.avg_actor_count AS excess_second
  FROM above_first AS c
  CROSS JOIN second_average AS a
  WHERE a.avg_actor_count IS NOT NULL
    AND c.actor_count > a.avg_actor_count
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actor_count), 0) AS total_actor_count,
       AVG(excess_first) AS average_excess_over_first_average,
       AVG(excess_second) AS average_excess_over_second_average
FROM above_second;

WITH film_actor_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
), first_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actor_count
  FROM film_actor_counts
), above_first AS (
  SELECT c.film_id, c.actor_count, c.actor_count - a.avg_actor_count AS excess_first
  FROM film_actor_counts AS c
  CROSS JOIN first_average AS a
  WHERE c.actor_count > a.avg_actor_count
), second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actor_count
  FROM above_first
), above_both AS (
  SELECT f.actor_count, f.excess_first,
         f.actor_count - a.avg_actor_count AS excess_second
  FROM above_first AS f
  CROSS JOIN second_average AS a
  WHERE f.actor_count > a.avg_actor_count
)
SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS sum_actor_counts,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_average,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_average
FROM above_both

WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.position,
        COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m
      ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
), total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
)
SELECT
    ma.member_id,
    ma.position,
    ma.attendance_count,
    1.0 * ma.attendance_count / NULLIF(t.attendance_count, 0) AS attendance_share
FROM member_attendance AS ma
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, ma.member_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id,
           m.position,
           COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m
      ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position
)
SELECT member_id,
       position,
       attendance_count,
       1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
FROM member_attendance
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY circuitId
), total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM races
)
SELECT cc.circuitId,
       cc.average_round,
       cc.race_count,
       CAST(cc.race_count AS REAL) / tr.total_count AS share
FROM circuit_counts AS cc
CROSS JOIN total_races AS tr
ORDER BY share DESC, cc.circuitId
LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS avg_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count,
         COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS race_share
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY race_share DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM circuit_counts
)
SELECT circuitId, avg_round, race_count, race_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY race_share DESC;

WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.type,
        AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount <> 0
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT
    type,
    avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio,
    avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio) OVER () AS distance_from_mean_of_type_averages
FROM type_averages;

WITH per_type AS (
    SELECT e.type,
           AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_to_amount_ratio
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e
      ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent <> 0
    GROUP BY e.type
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT type,
           avg_spent_to_amount_ratio,
           AVG(avg_spent_to_amount_ratio) OVER () AS mean_of_type_averages
    FROM per_type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_spent_to_amount_ratio,
       ABS(avg_spent_to_amount_ratio - mean_of_type_averages) AS distance_from_mean_of_type_averages
FROM with_mean;

WITH type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM type_rates
)
SELECT
  tr.Name,
  tr.rate,
  tr.track_count,
  tr.rate - o.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM type_rates AS tr
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE tr.rate > o.avg_rate;

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS films_in_stock
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), above_average AS (
  SELECT rating, films_in_stock,
         AVG(films_in_stock) OVER () AS across_rating_average
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT SUM(films_in_stock) AS total_films_in_stock,
       AVG(films_in_stock - across_rating_average) AS avg_above_rating_average
FROM above_average
WHERE films_in_stock > across_rating_average

WITH copies_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copy_count
  FROM copies_by_rating
)
SELECT SUM(c.copy_count) AS total_copies,
       AVG(c.copy_count - a.avg_copy_count) AS avg_excess_copies
FROM copies_by_rating AS c
CROSS JOIN average_count AS a
WHERE c.copy_count > a.avg_copy_count

WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT s.questregistry,
         si.healtheval,
         s.scancount,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
), status_stats AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
         AVG(scancount) AS avg_count
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY healtheval
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_stats
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT ss.avg_rate, ss.avg_count, o.all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_stats AS ss
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE o.all_status_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_rate > o.all_status_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(avg_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM qualifying;

WITH site_status AS (
  SELECT s.questregistry, s.zoneref, t.healtheval,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry

  SELECT healtheval,
         AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
         COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) AS distinct_sites
  FROM site_status
  GROUP BY healtheval
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_rate) OVER () AS all_status_avg
  FROM status_stats
), selected AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM above_average
  WHERE all_status_avg IS NOT NULL AND avg_rate > all_status_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate_of_statuses,
       AVG(distinct_sites) AS avg_distinct_sites,
       AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg) AS avg_excess_over_all_status_avg
FROM selected;

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS test_records
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(test_records) AS total_records,
           AVG(CAST(test_records AS REAL)) AS average_per_sex
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT s.SEX,
       s.test_records,
       CAST(s.test_records AS REAL) / t.total_records AS share_of_total,
       s.test_records - t.average_per_sex AS above_average
FROM sex_counts AS s
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE s.test_records > t.average_per_sex;

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(test_count) AS avg_count
    FROM sex_counts
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT sc.sex, sc.test_count, a.avg_count
    FROM sex_counts AS sc
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE sc.test_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT sex,
       test_count,
       CAST(test_count AS REAL) / SUM(test_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_qualifying_total,
       test_count - avg_count AS above_group_average
FROM qualifying;

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT sc.observstation,
       sc.telescope_count,
       sc.telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS share_of_total
FROM station_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, sc.observstation
LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS telescope_share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY telescope_share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
), side_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM side_counts
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sc.order_count), 0) AS total_count,
       AVG(sc.order_count - sa.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM side_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa
WHERE sc.order_count > sa.avg_count

WITH matched_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.recordvault, o.dealedge
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
), side_counts AS (
  SELECT dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM matched_orders
  GROUP BY dealedge
), above_average AS (
  SELECT order_count,
         AVG(order_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM side_counts
  WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM side_counts)
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(order_count - average_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(t.amount) AS account_average
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(figure) AS all_region_average
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT
    r.region,
    r.figure,
    r.figure - o.all_region_average AS excess,
    r.figure / o.all_region_average AS figure_divided_by_average
FROM region_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE r.figure > o.all_region_average;

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.avg_amount) AS figure
    FROM account_averages aa
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(figure) AS avg_figure
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.figure,
       r.figure - o.avg_figure AS excess_over_average,
       r.figure / o.avg_figure AS ratio_to_average
FROM region_averages r
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.figure > o.avg_figure;

SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS conserved_site_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
GROUP BY s.insurstat;

FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
GROUP BY s.insurstat;
