WITH status_site_counts AS (
  SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.insurstat
)
SELECT insurstat, site_count,
       site_count::numeric / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share
FROM status_site_counts
ORDER BY insurstat NULLS FIRST;

WITH hand_totals AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '(blank/missing)'
            ELSE p.bats
        END AS hand,
        COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_award AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY 1
), shares AS (
    SELECT hand, tally,
           1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_totals
), scored AS (
    SELECT hand, tally, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT hand, tally, share, share - average_share AS excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY hand;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM player_award AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
),
shares AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           award_count,
           1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       award_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS player_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
), college_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS all_colleges_avg,
           SUM(player_count) AS total_player_count
    FROM college_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT cc.player_count,
           cs.all_colleges_avg,
           cs.total_player_count
    FROM college_counts AS cc
    CROSS JOIN college_stats AS cs
    WHERE cc.player_count > cs.all_colleges_avg
)
SELECT AVG(player_count) AS above_average_colleges_avg_player_count,
       AVG(player_count * 1.0 / total_player_count) AS avg_fraction_of_total,
       AVG(player_count - all_colleges_avg) AS avg_excess_over_all_colleges_avg
FROM above_average

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count,
           SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT player_count
    FROM college_counts
    CROSS JOIN overall
    WHERE player_count > avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(player_count * 1.0 / total_count) AS average_share_of_total,
       AVG(player_count - avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average
CROSS JOIN overall

WITH invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
  FROM Orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
), shares AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         invoice_count,
         1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share
  FROM invoice_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT invoice_count,
         invoice_share,
         AVG(invoice_share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE invoice_share > (SELECT AVG(invoice_share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(invoice_share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

WITH order_invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
  FROM Orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoice_count
  FROM order_invoice_counts
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(1.0 * c.invoice_count / NULLIF(t.total_invoice_count, 0)) AS average_share,
         t.total_invoice_count
  FROM order_invoice_counts AS c
  CROSS JOIN totals AS t
  GROUP BY t.total_invoice_count
)
SELECT SUM(c.invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
       AVG(1.0 * c.invoice_count / o.total_invoice_count) AS average_share,
       AVG(1.0 * c.invoice_count / o.total_invoice_count - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM order_invoice_counts AS c
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE 1.0 * c.invoice_count / o.total_invoice_count > o.average_share;

WITH account_metrics AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, a.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY d.A3, a.account_id), region_metrics AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg, AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg FROM account_metrics GROUP BY region), region_mean AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg FROM region_metrics) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / m.mean_amount_avg AS amount_avg_ratio FROM region_metrics r CROSS JOIN region_mean m WHERE m.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_account_amount,
        AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) AS mean_region_amount
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT
    r.region,
    r.avg_account_amount,
    r.avg_account_balance,
    r.avg_account_amount / o.mean_region_amount AS ratio
FROM region_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE o.mean_region_amount IS NOT NULL;

WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT
        b.player_id,
        p.bats AS batting_hand,
        AVG(b."double") AS average_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason AS b
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
    GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        batting_hand,
        average_doubles,
        average_doubles / AVG(average_doubles) OVER () AS relative_index
    FROM player_averages
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        batting_hand,
        average_doubles,
        relative_index,
        relative_index - AVG(relative_index) OVER (PARTITION BY batting_hand) AS gap
    FROM indexed
)
SELECT player_id, batting_hand, average_doubles, relative_index, gap
FROM with_gaps
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.bats,
        AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason AS bp
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL
      AND p.bats <> ''
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
player_indices AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        average_doubles,
        average_doubles / AVG(average_doubles) OVER () AS index
    FROM player_averages
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        average_doubles,
        index,
        index - AVG(index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference
    FROM player_indices
)
SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, index, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.frequency,
        AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t
      ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        frequency,
        average_transaction_amount,
        average_transaction_amount /
            AVG(average_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    frequency,
    average_transaction_amount,
    ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        a.frequency,
        AVG(t.amount) AS account_average
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency
),
frequency_averages AS (
    SELECT
        frequency,
        AVG(account_average) AS frequency_average
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT
    aa.account_id,
    aa.frequency,
    aa.account_average,
    aa.account_average / fa.frequency_average AS ratio
FROM account_averages AS aa
JOIN frequency_averages AS fa
  ON fa.frequency = aa.frequency
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
         AVG(s.aream2 / s.volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), eligible AS (
  SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM per_source
  WHERE area_to_volume_ratio IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS simple_average_ratio
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT e.fundflux,
       e.avg_y_vs_x_difference,
       e.area_to_volume_ratio,
       e.area_to_volume_ratio - o.simple_average_ratio AS above_average_by
FROM eligible AS e
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE e.area_to_volume_ratio > o.simple_average_ratio;

WITH funding_source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / NULLIF(ss.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    SUM(ss.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
with_cross_source_average AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS cross_source_average
  FROM funding_source_stats
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  avg_y_vs_x_difference,
  area_to_volume_ratio,
  area_to_volume_ratio - cross_source_average AS amount_above_average
FROM with_cross_source_average
WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > cross_source_average;

WITH status_counts AS (
    SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status,
       attendee_count,
       CAST(attendee_count AS REAL) / SUM(attendee_count) OVER () AS share
FROM status_counts;

WITH members_per_status AS (
    SELECT e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status,
       member_count,
       1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS proportion
FROM members_per_status;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval, record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(ss.record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ss.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM status_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE ss.share > a.average_share;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT sc.record_count, sc.share, a.average_share
  FROM status_shares AS sc
  CROSS JOIN averages AS a
  WHERE sc.share > a.average_share
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

WITH quantities AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS order_avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY order_id
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS overall_avg_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
)
SELECT q.order_id,
       q.order_avg_quantity,
       q.order_avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS average_difference
FROM quantities AS q
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY average_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH item_quantities AS (
  SELECT order_id, CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) AS quantity
  FROM Order_Items
),
order_averages AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity
  FROM item_quantities
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity) AS baseline_quantity
  FROM item_quantities
)
SELECT oa.order_id,
       oa.average_quantity,
       oa.average_quantity - b.baseline_quantity AS difference
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.baseline_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH station_averages AS (

  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation

)
SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandusagepct, station_count,
       station_count * 1.0 / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM phase_stats
ORDER BY lunarstage NULLS FIRST;

WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
), phase_summary AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_averages
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  station_count,
  station_count::numeric / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS station_fraction
FROM phase_summary;

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        oc.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        oc.order_count,
        oc.order_count - AVG(oc.order_count) OVER () AS difference
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference
FROM ranked
ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id
LIMIT 10

WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, a.district_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        c.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        c.order_count,
        c.order_count - AVG(c.order_count) OVER () AS difference
    FROM account_order_counts AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference
FROM ranked
WHERE difference >= (
    SELECT difference
    FROM ranked
    ORDER BY difference DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id;

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS mean_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
), first_cut AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length
  FROM rating_averages ra
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ra.avg_length > om.mean_length
), first_cut_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length
  FROM first_cut
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fc.avg_length
  FROM first_cut fc
  CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean fcm
  WHERE fc.avg_length > fcm.mean_length
)
SELECT AVG(r.avg_length) AS mean_remaining_average_length,
       AVG(r.avg_length - om.mean_length) AS avg_above_overall_mean,
       AVG(r.avg_length - fcm.mean_length) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean
FROM remaining r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
CROSS JOIN first_cut_mean fcm

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length, b.avg_length AS baseline_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ra.avg_length > b.avg_length), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length FROM above_baseline), remaining AS (SELECT ab.avg_length, ab.baseline_length, km.avg_length AS kept_mean_length FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE ab.avg_length > km.avg_length) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_remaining_rating_avg_length, AVG(avg_length - baseline_length) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(avg_length - kept_mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM remaining

WITH manager_awards AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country
), ranked AS (
    SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count,
           1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share
    FROM manager_awards
)
SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH manager_awards AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
), counts AS (
    SELECT manager_id, death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_awards
    GROUP BY manager_id, death_country
)
SELECT manager_id,
       death_country,
       award_count,
       1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share
FROM counts
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH item_town AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS item_avg_price,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), town_averages AS (
    SELECT
        town_city,
        AVG(item_avg_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM item_town
    GROUP BY town_city
), cross_town AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS cross_town_average_ratio
    FROM town_averages
)
SELECT
    t.town_city AS town,
    t.average_price,
    t.average_ratio,
    t.average_ratio - x.cross_town_average_ratio AS amount_above_cross_town_average
FROM town_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x
WHERE t.average_ratio > x.cross_town_average_ratio;

WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS item_avg_price,
    AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), town_averages AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    AVG(item_avg_price) AS average_price,
    AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
), with_cross_town_average AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    average_price,
    average_ratio,
    AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS cross_town_average_ratio
  FROM town_averages
)
SELECT
  town_city,
  average_price,
  average_ratio,
  average_ratio - cross_town_average_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM with_cross_town_average
WHERE average_ratio > cross_town_average_ratio;

WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall_average_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(mtr.rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(1.0 * mtr.track_count) AS average_number_of_tracks,
  AVG(mtr.rate - o.overall_average_rate) AS average_margin_above_overall_average
FROM media_type_rates AS mtr
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE mtr.rate > o.overall_average_rate;

WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_rates
), above_average AS (
  SELECT mr.byte_rate, mr.track_count, o.avg_rate
  FROM media_rates AS mr
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE mr.byte_rate > o.avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_byte_rate,
       AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(byte_rate - avg_rate) AS average_excess_byte_rate
FROM above_average;

WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
), shares AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo,
         employee_count,
         1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM group_counts
)
SELECT ReportsTo,
       employee_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

  FROM Employee

  GROUP BY ReportsTo

       employee_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average

LIMIT 10;

WITH matched_transactions AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind
  FROM transactionrecord AS tx
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
), per_type AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS type_count
  FROM matched_transactions
  GROUP BY tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    type_count,
    SUM(type_count) OVER () AS total_count,
    AVG(type_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  type_count,
  type_count::numeric / total_count AS share_of_total,
  type_count::numeric - average_count AS above_average_by
FROM stats
WHERE type_count > average_count
ORDER BY tradekind NULLS FIRST;

WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS trader_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT tradekind, trader_count,
         SUM(trader_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(trader_count) OVER () AS avg_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT tradekind, trader_count,
       trader_count::numeric / total_count AS proportion_of_total,
       trader_count - avg_count AS count_minus_average
FROM stats
WHERE avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND trader_count > avg_count;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  INNER JOIN sites AS s
    ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_reference,
       insurstat AS insurance_status,
       record_count,
       record_count::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched), 0) AS share_of_matched_records
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share_of_matched_records DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    sc.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    COUNT(*) AS conservation_count
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
fractions AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    conservation_count,
    conservation_count::numeric / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS fraction
  FROM grouped
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    conservation_count,
    fraction,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS fraction_rank
  FROM fractions
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE fraction_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurstat NULLS LAST, zoneref;

WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS across_rating_avg
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
       AVG(p.avg_daily_price - b.across_rating_avg) AS avg_above_across_rating_avg
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE p.avg_daily_price > b.across_rating_avg;

WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_rating
), above AS (
  SELECT p.avg_per_day, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_rating p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_per_day > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_ratings,
       AVG(avg_per_day - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_overall_avg
FROM above;

WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS matched_order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT ordertune, matched_order_count,
         AVG(matched_order_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT AVG(matched_order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(matched_order_count - average_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average
WHERE matched_order_count > average_count;

  FROM riskandmargin AS rm

SELECT AVG(matched_order_count) AS average_count,

WITH counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), above_average AS (
  SELECT record_count
  FROM counts_by_type
  WHERE record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts_by_type)
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts_by_type)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
), status_avgs AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg
  FROM status_avgs AS sa
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
), qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.rfistat AS status,
       q.avg_modindex,
       q.avg_modindex - q.overall_avg AS above_average_by,
       q.avg_modindex - qm.mean_qualifying_avg AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS qm;

WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline_avg
  FROM signals
), status_avgs AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS status_avg
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
), kept AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.status_avg, b.baseline_avg
  FROM status_avgs AS sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.status_avg > b.baseline_avg
)
SELECT rfistat, status_avg, status_avg - baseline_avg AS above_baseline,
       status_avg - AVG(status_avg) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept;

WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    avg_fill,
    AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS timespan_avg_fill,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_fills
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  avg_fill - timespan_avg_fill AS above_timespan_average,
  fill_rank
FROM compared
WHERE avg_fill > timespan_avg_fill
  AND fill_rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank;

WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
), time_in_force_means AS (
  SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) AS mean_order_avg_fill
  FROM order_fills
  GROUP BY timespan
), ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    f.ordersmark,
    f.timespan,
    f.avg_fill,
    f.avg_fill - m.mean_order_avg_fill AS excess_over_mean,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.timespan
      ORDER BY f.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_fills AS f
  INNER JOIN time_in_force_means AS m
    ON f.timespan IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.timespan
  WHERE f.avg_fill > m.mean_order_avg_fill
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_over_mean, fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3;

WITH hand_tallies AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS throwing_hand,
        COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        tally,
        1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_tallies
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        tally,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(tally) AS total_tally,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM player_award AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
), hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throws, award_count,
           CAST(award_count AS REAL) / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT award_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM hand_shares
)
SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        member_count,
        1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
        1.0 * member_count / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
    FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_id, member_count, share_of_total, ratio_to_average
FROM metrics
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), metrics AS (SELECT major_id, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * member_count / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM major_counts) SELECT major_id, member_count, fraction_of_total, ratio_to_average FROM metrics ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_sex AS (

  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_ana,
       avg_ana / AVG(avg_ana) OVER () AS ana_average_ratio
FROM per_sex;

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, e.ID,
           AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
           AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID

WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races, COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM circuit_counts), shares AS (SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.race_count, 1.0 * cc.race_count / t.total_races AS race_share, 1.0 / t.circuit_count AS average_share FROM circuit_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT c.circuitId, c.name AS circuit_name, s.race_count, s.race_share, s.race_share - s.average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares s JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = s.circuitId ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), shares AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share,
         1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM circuit_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         share,
         share - average_share AS excess_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - average_share DESC) AS excess_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT circuitId,
       race_count,
       share,
       excess_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuit_counts)
  AND excess_rank <= 10
ORDER BY excess_share DESC

WITH race_country_wins AS (
  SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
), country_avgs AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_country_wins
  GROUP BY country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg
  FROM country_avgs
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, o.overall_avg
  FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
), group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - a.overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_above_average_group_average
FROM above_overall a
CROSS JOIN group_avg g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg
ORDER BY a.country;

WITH race_country_avgs AS (
  SELECT c.country, ds.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE ds.wins IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country, ds.raceId
), country_avgs AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_country_avgs
  GROUP BY country
), overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS benchmark
  FROM country_avgs
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ob.benchmark
  FROM country_avgs AS ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > ob.benchmark
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_above_overall
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT ao.country,
       ao.avg_wins AS average,
       ao.avg_wins - ao.benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark,
       ao.avg_wins - sm.mean_above_overall AS above_second_mean
FROM above_overall AS ao
CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
WHERE ao.avg_wins > sm.mean_above_overall;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sf.instownpct, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
), mix_averages AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
), above_average AS (
  SELECT m.instownpct, m.ordertypedist, o.avg_ownership
  FROM matched AS m
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership
)
SELECT
  AVG(a.instownpct) AS average_ownership,
  AVG(a.instownpct / ma.avg_ownership) AS average_ratio_to_mix_average,
  AVG(a.instownpct - a.avg_ownership) AS average_excess_overall
FROM above_average AS a
JOIN mix_averages AS ma
  ON ma.ordertypedist = a.ordertypedist;

WITH units AS (
    SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist, s.instownpct AS ownership
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg
    WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
      AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), baselined AS (
    SELECT units.*,
           AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_baseline,
           AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average
    FROM units
), kept AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM baselined
    WHERE ownership > overall_average
)
SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_kept_ownership,
       AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline_ratio,
       AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM kept;

WITH combination_counts AS (
    SELECT
        rm.ordervault AS order_reference,
        o.orderflow AS status,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM riskandmargin AS rm
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault
    GROUP BY rm.ordervault, o.orderflow
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        order_reference,
        status,
        record_count,
        record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share
    FROM combination_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        order_reference,
        status,
        record_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS above_status_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, share, above_status_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY above_status_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS order_reference,
    o.orderflow AS order_status,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault

WITH department_counts AS (

department_shares AS (

WITH per_gender AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_orders
    FROM Customers c

    JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
), above_average AS (
    SELECT invoiced_orders

    WHERE invoiced_orders > (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders * 1.0) FROM per_gender)
)
SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders * 1.0) AS average_figure,
       AVG(invoiced_orders * 1.0) - (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders * 1.0) FROM per_gender) AS average_excess

WITH per_gender AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count

    SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS overall_average
    FROM per_gender

CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE pg.invoiced_order_count > overall.overall_average;

WITH rating_ratios AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS films
  FROM film

with_average AS (

WITH rating_stats AS (

WITH funding_counts AS (

WITH projects_with_qc AS (

WITH telescope_averages AS (

  FROM signals

  GROUP BY telescref
), group_average AS (

SELECT ta.telescref,
       ta.avg_modindex,

       ta.avg_modindex / ga.overall_avg_modindex AS ratio_to_group_average

CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga

ORDER BY ratio_to_group_average DESC

WITH telescope_averages AS (

WITH matched AS (

), deviations AS (

WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS status,
         SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
         SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_gb_per_minute
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT status, total_scans, gb_per_minute,

WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
), copy_differences AS (

         copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS difference_from_rating_avg,
         copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_avg
  FROM film_copies
)
SELECT film_id, rating, copies, difference_from_rating_avg, difference_from_overall_avg
FROM copy_differences
ORDER BY difference_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH film_copy_counts AS (

  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
), deviations AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count,

WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS order_volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, order_volume, order_volume / NULLIF(SUM(order_volume) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM product_volumes), scored AS (SELECT product_id, order_volume, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(order_volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM scored WHERE share > average_share

WITH product_counts AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
    FROM Products AS p
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
), product_shares AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           item_count,
           1.0 * item_count / SUM(item_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM product_counts
), average_share AS (

  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON ab.translink = tx.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, analysis_count,
         analysis_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(analysis_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM type_counts
), averages AS (

  FROM shares

  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM compared
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;

WITH per_order AS (

SELECT

  AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate,

WITH order_averages AS (

benchmark AS (

above_benchmark AS (

  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_order_avg_net_fee_rate,

FROM above_benchmark;

WITH telescope_weather_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    s.telescref,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
), qualifying_groups AS (
  SELECT tw.*
  FROM telescope_weather_avgs AS tw
  CROSS JOIN overall AS ov
  WHERE tw.avg_modindex > ov.avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  qg.weathprofile,
  AVG(qg.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
  AVG(qg.avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
  AVG(qg.avg_modindex - ov.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_overall_modindex
FROM qualifying_groups AS qg
CROSS JOIN overall AS ov
GROUP BY qg.weathprofile;

WITH telescope_weather_groups AS (

    t.telescregistry,

  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_group_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_weather_groups
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM telescope_weather_groups AS g
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.mean_group_avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  weathprofile,
  AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
  AVG(avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift,
  AVG(avg_modindex - b.mean_group_avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
GROUP BY weathprofile;

WITH sex_averages AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0
  GROUP BY p.SEX
), first_filter AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS first_mean
  FROM sex_averages
), second_filter AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS second_mean
  FROM first_filter
  WHERE avg_ratio > first_mean
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_above_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_above_second_mean
FROM second_filter
WHERE avg_ratio > second_mean;

WITH test_ratios AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, 1.0 * l.CPK / l.GPT AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
      AND p.SEX <> ''
      AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT <> 0
), group_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM test_ratios
    GROUP BY SEX
), first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM group_averages
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT g.SEX, g.avg_ratio, m.mean_ratio AS first_mean
    FROM group_averages AS g
    CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m
    WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio
), second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
    SELECT f.avg_ratio, f.first_mean, m.mean_ratio AS second_mean
    FROM first_kept AS f
    CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
    WHERE f.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_remaining_group_ratio_averages,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           d.A3 AS region,
           COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a
      ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           region,
           account_count,
           AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average
    FROM district_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           region,
           account_count,
           region_average,
           account_count - region_average AS above_region_average
    FROM region_averages
    WHERE account_count > region_average
)
SELECT district_id,
       region,
       account_count,
       above_region_average,
       CAST(account_count AS REAL) / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio
FROM above_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
), regional_averages AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, account_count,
           AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg
    FROM district_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, account_count, region_avg
    FROM regional_averages
    WHERE account_count > region_avg
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(account_count) AS avg_account_count
    FROM above_average
), ranked AS (
    SELECT aa.district_id, aa.region, aa.account_count,
           aa.account_count - aa.region_avg AS excess,
           1.0 * aa.account_count / oa.avg_account_count AS ratio,
           RANK() OVER (
               ORDER BY 1.0 * aa.account_count / oa.avg_account_count DESC
           ) AS ratio_rank
    FROM above_average AS aa
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
)
SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE ratio_rank <= 10
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH scope_averages AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS averaged_over
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u
    ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  avg_net_fee_rate,
  averaged_over,
  avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS distance_from_simple_mean
FROM scope_averages;

WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, o.recordvault, f.feerate, f.rebrate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
), per_order AS (
  SELECT acctscope, recordvault,
         AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) AS net_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY acctscope, recordvault
  HAVING AVG(feerate) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(rebrate) IS NOT NULL
), per_scope AS (
  SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM per_order
  GROUP BY acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope, avg_net_rate, order_count,
       avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_scope_average
FROM per_scope;

WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT timespan,
         bucket_count,
         bucket_count::numeric / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT bucket_count, share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bucket_count), 0) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM bucket_shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(b.order_count) FILTER (WHERE s.share > s.average_share), 0) AS total_count,
  AVG(s.share) FILTER (WHERE s.share > s.average_share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.share - s.average_share) FILTER (WHERE s.share > s.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM bucket_counts AS b
JOIN scored AS s ON s.share = b.order_count::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM bucket_counts), 0);

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.share) AS avg_excess_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.share > a.share

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share;

WITH customer_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        c.state_county_province,
        ft.transaction_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
    JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
), state_totals AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        SUM(transaction_amount) AS state_total
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT
        state_total,
        state_total / NULLIF(SUM(state_total) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM state_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT
        state_total,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(state_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province,
         SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS transaction_total
  FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
  JOIN Accounts AS a
    ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  JOIN Customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         transaction_total,
         transaction_total / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_total) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM customer_totals
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         transaction_total,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(transaction_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  r.rating,
  r.avg_replacement_cost,
  r.avg_per_day_rate,
  r.avg_per_day_rate - c.avg_per_day_rate AS above_cross_rating_average
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_average AS c
WHERE r.avg_per_day_rate > c.avg_per_day_rate;

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ra.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
  AVG(ra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
  AVG(ra.avg_daily_price - cra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_average cra
WHERE ra.avg_daily_price > cra.avg_daily_price

WITH state_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count
    FROM Customers
    GROUP BY state_county_province
),
state_shares AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        customer_count,
        1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share_of_customers
    FROM state_customer_counts
),
state_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share_of_customers) AS average_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ss.customer_count) AS combined_account_base,
    AVG(ss.share_of_customers) AS average_share,
    AVG(ss.share_of_customers - sa.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM state_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN state_average AS sa
WHERE ss.share_of_customers > sa.average_share;

WITH customer_states AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.state_county_province
  FROM Customers c
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Accounts a
    WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  )
), state_counts AS (
  SELECT state_county_province, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM customer_states
  GROUP BY state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         customer_count,
         1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
), scored_states AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         customer_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored_states
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH country_tallies AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_shares AS (
    SELECT birth_country, tally,
           CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM country_tallies
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT tally, share,
           AVG(tally) OVER () AS average_tally
    FROM country_shares
)
SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(tally - average_tally) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average
WHERE tally > average_tally;

WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
country_shares AS (
    SELECT birth_country,
           record_count,
           CAST(record_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM country_counts
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT SUM(cs.record_count) AS total_record_count,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.record_count - oa.avg_record_count) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM country_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE cs.record_count > oa.avg_record_count;

SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS address_fraction

SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction_of_all_addresses

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
), counts AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT translink, tradekind, transaction_count,
         transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS overall_share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(overall_share) AS average_share
FROM shares
GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH transaction_trader_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
pairs_with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    transreg,
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM transaction_trader_pairs
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count_per_pair,
  AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share_per_pair
FROM pairs_with_shares
GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH matched_labs AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.PT, l.IGA, l.IGM
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
), patient_avgs AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX,
           AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(IGA - IGM) AS avg_iga_minus_igm
    FROM matched_labs
    GROUP BY ID, SEX

WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_survey_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(spatial_survey_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(spatial_survey_count::numeric) AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT sc.fundflux AS source,
       sc.spatial_survey_count AS count,
       sc.spatial_survey_count::numeric / t.total_count AS share,
       sc.spatial_survey_count::numeric - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM source_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE sc.spatial_survey_count > t.average_count;

WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    project_count,
    project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share,
    AVG(project_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  project_count,
  share,
  project_count - average_count AS above_average
FROM summary
WHERE project_count > average_count;

SELECT aa.account_id,

       aa.average_amount - oa.average_amount AS excess
FROM account_averages AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE aa.average_amount > oa.average_amount
