WITH signed_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CASE type
            WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END AS signed_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
), account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) AS average_amount
    FROM signed_transactions
    GROUP BY account_id
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_average
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT
    aa.account_id,
    aa.average_amount,
    aa.average_amount - om.mean_average AS above_mean
FROM account_averages AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE aa.average_amount > om.mean_average
ORDER BY above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH college_income AS (
    SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.college
)
SELECT college,
       total_income_amount,
       1.0 * total_income_amount / SUM(total_income_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_total_income
FROM college_income;

WITH college_income AS (
    SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.college
)
SELECT college,
       total_income,
       CAST(total_income AS REAL) / SUM(total_income) OVER () AS income_fraction
FROM college_income;

WITH id_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
    SELECT ID,
           record_count,
           1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM id_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT record_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
    SELECT record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM group_counts
), benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM shares
), kept AS (
    SELECT gc.record_count, s.share, b.average_share
    FROM group_counts AS gc
    JOIN shares AS s ON s.share = gc.record_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM group_counts)
    CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
    WHERE s.share > b.average_share
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM kept

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
        AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    ia.invoice_number,
    ia.average_quantity,
    ia.relative_gap,
    ia.average_quantity - oa.overall_average_quantity AS above_overall_average
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_quantity > oa.overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) AS total_product_cost,
    SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    average_quantity,
    (total_product_cost - total_total_cost) / NULLIF(total_total_cost, 0) AS cost_ratio,
    AVG(average_quantity) OVER () AS overall_average_quantity
  FROM invoice_stats
)
SELECT
  invoice_number,
  average_quantity,
  cost_ratio,
  average_quantity - overall_average_quantity AS quantity_above_overall_average
FROM with_overall
WHERE average_quantity > overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_overall_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(i.income_id) AS income_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.link_to_major
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT dc.major_id, dc.income_count,
           1.0 * dc.income_count / SUM(dc.income_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts AS dc
), above_average AS (
    SELECT income_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
)
SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.link_to_major
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT maj.department,
           dc.member_count,
           1.0 * dc.member_count / SUM(dc.member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts AS dc
    JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = dc.major_id
), averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
), qualifying AS (
    SELECT ds.member_count, ds.share, a.average_share
    FROM department_shares AS ds
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE ds.share > a.average_share
)
SELECT SUM(member_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM qualifying

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_winners AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_size, p.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS first_margin
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS benchmark
  FROM first_winners
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT w.avg_fill_size,
         w.first_margin,
         w.avg_fill_size - b.benchmark AS second_margin
  FROM first_winners w
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE w.avg_fill_size > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS average_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(first_margin) AS average_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(second_margin) AS average_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders;

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_excess AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill,
         avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS excess1
  FROM per_order
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill, excess1
  FROM first_excess
  WHERE excess1 > 0
), second_excess AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill, excess1,
         avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS excess2
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT avg_fill, excess1, excess2
  FROM second_excess
  WHERE excess2 > 0
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_final_order_fill,
       AVG(excess1) AS avg_first_excess,
       AVG(excess2) AS avg_second_excess
FROM final_kept;

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT CASE
               WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN '<missing>'
               WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '<blank>'
               ELSE p.SEX
           END AS sex_group,
           COUNT(*) AS examined_count
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY CASE
                 WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN '<missing>'
                 WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '<blank>'
                 ELSE p.SEX
             END
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(examined_count) AS overall_total,
           AVG(1.0 * examined_count) AS per_sex_average
    FROM sex_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT sc.*,
           1.0 * sc.examined_count / t.overall_total AS share,
           t.per_sex_average
    FROM sex_counts sc
    CROSS JOIN totals t
    WHERE sc.examined_count > t.per_sex_average
)
SELECT 'sex' AS row_type,
       sex_group,
       examined_count AS total,
       1.0 * examined_count / t.overall_total AS share_of_overall,
       NULL AS average_amount_above_per_sex_average
FROM sex_counts
CROSS JOIN totals t
UNION ALL
SELECT 'above_average_combined',
       NULL,
       SUM(examined_count),
       AVG(share),
       AVG(examined_count - per_sex_average)
FROM above_average;

WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_missing,
        CASE
            WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN ''
            ELSE p.SEX
        END AS sex_group,
        COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY
        CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        examination_count,
        1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share,
        AVG(examination_count) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT
    SUM(examination_count) AS total_examination_count,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(examination_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM scored
WHERE examination_count > average_count;
SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_inventory FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY share_of_inventory DESC, film_id LIMIT 10;

WITH film_copy_counts AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY film_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT film_id,
         copy_count,
         copy_count / SUM(copy_count) OVER () AS share_of_inventory,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copy_count DESC) AS copy_rank
  FROM film_copy_counts
)
SELECT film_id, copy_count, share_of_inventory
FROM ranked
WHERE copy_rank <= 10
ORDER BY copy_count DESC, film_id;

WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o."timespan", COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM "riskandmargin" AS r
  JOIN "orders" AS o
    ON r."ordervault" = o."recordvault"
  GROUP BY o."timespan"
), shares AS (
  SELECT "timespan",
         risk_margin_count,
         risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT "timespan",
       risk_margin_count,
       share_of_total,
       share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares;

WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o."timespan", COUNT(DISTINCT o."recordvault") AS order_count
  FROM "riskandmargin" AS r
  JOIN "orders" AS o
    ON r."ordervault" = o."recordvault"
  GROUP BY o."timespan"
), shares AS (
  SELECT "timespan", order_count,
         order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT "timespan",
       order_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares;

WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        CAST(order_count AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`), 0) AS share
    FROM account_order_counts
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share;

WITH account_shares AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS value
    FROM account_shares
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT account_shares.share
    FROM account_shares
    CROSS JOIN average_share
    WHERE account_shares.share > average_share.value
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(order_count)
        FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id) AS counts
        WHERE order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) > (SELECT value FROM average_share)) AS total_orders,
       AVG(above_average.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(above_average.share - average_share.value) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
CROSS JOIN average_share

WITH product_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_product_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) AS order_item_share
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
), type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
    AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
  FROM product_metrics
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
  AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
  AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
FROM type_averages

WITH product_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_type_description,
    avg_quantity,
    order_item_count,
    CAST(order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,10)) /
      NULLIF(SUM(order_item_count) OVER (), 0) AS order_item_share
  FROM product_stats
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
  FROM product_shares
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_quantity,
  AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
  AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS average_share
FROM type_averages

WITH invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS product_cost_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    product_cost_ratio,
    line_item_count,
    product_cost_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(product_cost_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio
  FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT invoice_number, product_cost_ratio, line_item_count, relative_ratio
FROM scored
WHERE relative_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH invoice_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_line_items
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT
  im.invoice_number,
  im.cost_ratio,
  im.number_of_line_items,
  im.cost_ratio / NULLIF(oa.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM invoice_metrics AS im
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE oa.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        avg_spent,
        avg_remaining,
        avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS difference
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        avg_spent,
        avg_remaining,
        AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS mean_event_avg_remaining
    FROM per_event
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_spent,
    avg_remaining,
    avg_remaining - mean_event_avg_remaining AS difference
FROM with_mean
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH site_groups AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing AS sp
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    insurance_status,
    avg_remaining_storage,
    avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
    avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER (), 0) AS storage_ratio
  FROM site_groups
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  insurance_status,
  avg_remaining_storage,
  avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  storage_ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference
  FROM scanprocessing AS sp
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    insurance_status,
    avg_remaining_storage,
    avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference,
    avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER (), 0) AS storage_ratio
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  insurance_status,
  avg_remaining_storage,
  avg_abs_cpu_gpu_difference,
  storage_ratio
FROM scored
WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) FROM group_averages) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.location,
        AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_overspend_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        location,
        average_overspend_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY location
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN average_overspend_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                     average_overspend_ratio DESC
        ) AS rank
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT event_id, location, average_overspend_ratio, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank, event_id;

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.location,
        AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(e.location) <> ''
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        location,
        average_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY location
            ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS event_rank
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE event_rank <= 3;

WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS cross_currency_avg_rebate
  FROM per_currency
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT
    pc.avg_rebate,
    pc.avg_relative_gap,
    pc.avg_rebate - b.cross_currency_avg_rebate AS excess_rebate
  FROM per_currency pc
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE b.cross_currency_avg_rebate IS NOT NULL
    AND pc.avg_rebate > b.cross_currency_avg_rebate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_average_maker_rebate,
  AVG(avg_relative_gap) AS mean_average_relative_gap,
  AVG(excess_rebate) AS mean_excess_over_cross_currency_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_currency_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebtotal) AS avg_rebate_above_benchmark,
       AVG(p.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap_above_benchmark,
       AVG(p.avg_rebtotal - b.mean_currency_avg_rebtotal) AS avg_excess_above_benchmark
FROM per_currency AS p
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE p.avg_rebtotal > b.mean_currency_avg_rebtotal;

WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT event_status,
           AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
      AND spent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY event_status
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
      AND spent IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.event_status,
       s.average_left_over,
       s.average_left_over - o.average_left_over AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM status_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.average_left_over IS NOT NULL;

WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_difference FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS average_of_status_averages FROM status_averages) SELECT event_status AS status, average_difference AS average, average_difference - average_of_status_averages AS average_minus_baseline FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE average_of_status_averages IS NOT NULL AND average_difference IS NOT NULL

WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
benchmarks AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction
),
kept AS (
  SELECT
    p.transref,
    p.avg_anlycount,
    b.overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmarks AS b
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > b.overall_avg
),
with_kept_avg AS (
  SELECT
    k.*,
    AVG(k.avg_anlycount) OVER () AS kept_avg
  FROM kept AS k
)
SELECT
  transref,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_anlycount - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
  avg_anlycount - kept_avg AS above_kept_avg
FROM with_kept_avg
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT
    transref,

  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
scored AS (

    transref,

),
kept AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    avg_anlycount,
    above_overall,
    avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_average

  WHERE avg_anlycount > overall_average
)
SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, above_kept_average
FROM kept
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC NULLS LAST

WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count
  FROM circuits AS c
  LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(qualifying_count) AS total_qualifying,
         COUNT(*) AS city_count
  FROM city_counts
), shares AS (
  SELECT cc.city,
         cc.qualifying_count,
         1.0 * cc.qualifying_count / t.total_qualifying AS share,
         1.0 / t.city_count AS average_share
  FROM city_counts AS cc
  CROSS JOIN totals AS t
)
SELECT city,
       qualifying_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY city

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX,
           AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb,
           AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
), sex_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX,
           AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb,
           AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_sex_avg_alb
    FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_un_tbil_ratio,
       s.avg_alb - o.mean_sex_avg_alb AS above_mean
FROM sex_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.avg_alb > o.mean_sex_avg_alb;

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb,
        AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb,
        AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio

WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_bandusage) AS avg_of_phase_averages,
  SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(p.avg_bandusage - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_phase_avg;

WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o."lunarstage", AVG(t."bandusagepct") AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM "telescopes" AS t JOIN "observatories" AS o ON t."observstation" = o."observstation" GROUP BY o."lunarstage"), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandusage) AS kept_phases_avg_bandusage, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS kept_phases_telescope_count, AVG(p.avg_bandusage - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess_above_mean FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_phase_avg

WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) AS avg_constructor_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_constructor_wins
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
  country,
  avg_constructor_points,
  avg_constructor_wins,
  avg_constructor_wins - AVG(avg_constructor_wins) OVER () AS wins_above_or_below_country_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country;

WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT ci.country, r.raceId,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY ci.country, r.raceId
), country_avg AS (
  SELECT country,
         AVG(avg_points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM per_race
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_minus_country_mean
FROM country_avg;

WITH account_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id,
         c.town_city,
         COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM Accounts AS a
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
town_counts AS (
  SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_transaction_count
  FROM account_counts
  GROUP BY town_city
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ac.account_id,
         ac.town_city,
         ac.transaction_count,
         1.0 * ac.transaction_count / NULLIF(tc.town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share,
         1.0 * ac.transaction_count / NULLIF(AVG(ac.transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average
  FROM account_counts AS ac
  JOIN town_counts AS tc ON tc.town_city = ac.town_city
)
SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, town_transaction_share, ratio_to_average
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id
LIMIT 10

WITH account_counts AS (

    FROM Accounts AS a

      ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id

    town_city,
    transaction_count,
    town_transaction_share,
    ratio_to_town_average
FROM town_metrics
ORDER BY ratio_to_town_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sa.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
       AVG(sa.mean_usage - oa.mean_usage) AS average_above_overall
FROM station_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE sa.mean_usage > oa.mean_usage;

  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(ta.avg_usage) AS mean_station_average,
       AVG(ta.avg_usage - b.avg_usage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM telescope_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE ta.avg_usage > b.avg_usage;

WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_pulse_rate, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_telescope p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_of_kept
  FROM above_overall
), final_telescope AS (
  SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.overall_avg, s.avg_of_kept
  FROM above_overall a
  CROSS JOIN second_avg s
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > s.avg_of_kept
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - overall_avg) AS mean_above_overall_average,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - avg_of_kept) AS mean_above_second_average
FROM final_telescope;

WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals

), first_baseline AS (

  FROM per_telescope
), above_first AS (
  SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_pulse_rate, b.baseline AS first_baseline
  FROM per_telescope p
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline b
  WHERE p.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
), second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM above_first
), final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.first_baseline, b.baseline AS second_baseline
  FROM above_first a
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline b
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > b.baseline
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - second_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline
FROM final_telescopes;

WITH event_attendance AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), total_attendance AS (
    SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
    FROM event_attendance
)
SELECT ea.event_id,
       ea.attendance_count,
       CAST(ea.attendance_count AS REAL) / ta.total_count AS share_of_total_attendance
FROM event_attendance AS ea
CROSS JOIN total_attendance AS ta
WHERE ta.total_count > 0
ORDER BY share_of_total_attendance DESC, ea.event_id
LIMIT 10

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), shares AS (
    SELECT event_id,
           attendance_count,
           CAST(attendance_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(attendance_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM per_event
)
SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share
FROM shares
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average
  FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, execution_count, share, share_above_average
FROM ranked
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM grouped
), scored AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
  FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
), Shares AS (
  SELECT CustomerId,
         CustomerTotal,
         CustomerTotal * 1.0 / SUM(CustomerTotal) OVER () AS RevenueShare
  FROM CustomerTotals
), AboveAverage AS (
  SELECT CustomerTotal, RevenueShare
  FROM Shares
  WHERE RevenueShare > (SELECT AVG(RevenueShare) FROM Shares)
)
SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal) AS AverageAmountSpent,
       AVG(RevenueShare) AS AverageShare,
       AVG(RevenueShare - (SELECT AVG(RevenueShare) FROM Shares)) AS AverageShareAboveAverage
FROM AboveAverage;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), shares AS (
    SELECT CustomerId,
           total_spent,
           total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS revenue_share
    FROM customer_totals
), measured AS (
    SELECT total_spent,
           revenue_share,
           AVG(revenue_share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS average_total_spent,
       AVG(revenue_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(revenue_share - average_share) AS average_share_difference
FROM measured
WHERE revenue_share > average_share

WITH site_counts AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
), shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, feature_count,
         feature_count::numeric / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share,
         1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM site_counts
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       feature_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS margin_above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH record_shares AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    traitcount::numeric / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin
  FROM record_shares
)
SELECT
  zoneref,
  traitcount,
  share,
  margin
FROM ranked
WHERE margin > 0
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share

)
SELECT
  observstation,

  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
), differences AS (
  SELECT

FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;

WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT
    cr.raceId,
    COUNT(*) AS entry_count,
    SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  GROUP BY cr.raceId
),
entry_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS average_entries
  FROM race_totals
)
SELECT
  rt.raceId,
  c.country,
  rt.total_constructor_points,
  rt.entry_count,
  rt.entry_count - ea.average_entries AS difference_from_average
FROM race_totals AS rt
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = rt.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
CROSS JOIN entry_average AS ea
WHERE rt.entry_count > ea.average_entries
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, rt.raceId
LIMIT 10;

WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    c.country,
    SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
    COUNT(*) AS entry_count
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entry_count
  FROM race_totals
)
SELECT
  rt.raceId,
  rt.country,
  rt.total_points,
  rt.entry_count,
  rt.entry_count - ac.avg_entry_count AS above_average
FROM race_totals AS rt
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE rt.entry_count > ac.avg_entry_count
ORDER BY above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_category AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count,
        AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
category_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count
    FROM per_category
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT pc.*,
           ca.avg_line_count
    FROM per_category AS pc
    CROSS JOIN category_average AS ca
    WHERE pc.line_count > ca.avg_line_count
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS average_relative_overspend,
    AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS average_budget_lines,
    AVG(line_count * 1.0 - avg_line_count) AS average_lines_above_category_average
FROM above_average;

WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN spent <> 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
                THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount
            END) AS avg_relative_overspend,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
with_baseline AS (
    SELECT
        avg_relative_overspend,
        line_count,
        AVG(line_count) OVER () AS avg_line_count
    FROM category_stats
),
selected AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM with_baseline
    WHERE line_count > avg_line_count
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend,
    AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count,
    AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count
FROM selected;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
), total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_order_count
  FROM Orders
)
SELECT coc.customer_id,
       coc.order_count,
       1.0 * coc.order_count / NULLIF(t.total_order_count, 0) AS order_share
FROM customer_order_counts AS coc
CROSS JOIN total_orders AS t
ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
), shares AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_count,
         1.0 * order_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share
  FROM customer_order_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_count,
         order_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC;

WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(w) AS average_wins,
        AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
with_gap AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        average_wins,
        average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses,
        average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS gap_above_mean
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    average_wins,
    average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses,
    gap_above_mean
FROM with_gap
WHERE average_wins > (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM team_averages)
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(w) AS avg_wins,
        AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        avg_wins,
        avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses,
        AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    avg_wins,
    avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses,
    avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendees
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
    GROUP BY z.city
), city_shares AS (
    SELECT city,
           attendees,
           1.0 * attendees / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
), averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(attendees) AS avg_attendees,
           AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.attendees) AS avg_attendees,
       AVG(cs.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(cs.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_share
FROM city_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE cs.share > a.avg_share;

WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
    GROUP BY z.city
), city_shares AS (
    SELECT city, attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.attendance_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.share - oa.average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_average
FROM city_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE cs.share > oa.average_share;

WITH linked AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
), deviations AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm,
           acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM linked
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation,
       excess AS `excess above sex average`
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH linked AS (
    SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
), centered AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm,
           acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM linked
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
    FROM centered
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation,
       excess AS `excess above sex average`

WITH pattern_averages AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
), above_patterns AS (
    SELECT pattern, avg_acl_igg
    FROM pattern_averages
    WHERE avg_acl_igg > (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM pattern_averages)
)
SELECT pattern,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_acl_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM pattern_averages) AS above_cross_pattern_average,
       avg_acl_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM above_patterns) AS from_above_patterns_average
FROM above_patterns;

WITH pattern_averages AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> ''
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_group_avg
    FROM pattern_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_acl_igg, o.mean_group_avg
    FROM pattern_averages p
    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE p.avg_acl_igg > o.mean_group_avg
)
SELECT pattern,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_acl_igg - mean_group_avg AS above_mean,
       avg_acl_igg - AVG(avg_acl_igg) OVER () AS from_kept_patterns_mean
FROM kept;

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event,
           ea.avg_amount,
           ea.avg_amount - oa.avg_amount AS above_overall_gap
    FROM event_averages ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.avg_amount
),
with_above_mean AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS mean_above_average
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       above_overall_gap,
       avg_amount - mean_above_average AS gap_from_above_average_mean
FROM with_above_mean
ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           avg_amount,
           AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS overall_avg
    FROM per_event
    WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM per_event)
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       avg_amount - overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       avg_amount - AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS above_kept_events_avg
FROM above_overall
ORDER BY above_kept_events_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH source_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>') AS funding_source,
        AVG(ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS size
    FROM projects AS p
    JOIN scanspatial AS ss
      ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
    WHERE ss.boxy IS NOT NULL
      AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '<missing>')
),
with_average_size AS (
    SELECT
        funding_source,
        avg_ratio,
        size,
        AVG(size) OVER () AS average_size
    FROM source_metrics
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    SUM(size) AS combined_size,
    AVG(size - average_size) AS avg_excess_size
FROM with_average_size
WHERE size > average_size;

WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count
  FROM source_stats
),
kept AS (
  SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.record_count, t.avg_record_count
  FROM source_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
  WHERE s.record_count > t.avg_record_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_kept_sources_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_spatial_records,
  AVG(record_count - avg_record_count) AS average_count_excess
FROM kept;

    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id

WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT p.player_id,
           p.death_country,
           SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total

WITH store_counts AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM store AS s
  LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_id
)
SELECT store_id,
       customer_count,
       customer_count / NULLIF(SUM(customer_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_all_customers,
       customer_count / NULLIF(AVG(customer_count) OVER (), 0) AS multiple_of_average_store_count
FROM store_counts
ORDER BY store_id;

WITH store_counts AS (
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM customer
  GROUP BY store_id
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers,
         AVG(customer_count) AS average_per_store
  FROM store_counts
)
SELECT sc.store_id,
       sc.customer_count,
       sc.customer_count / t.total_customers AS share_of_total,
       sc.customer_count / t.average_per_store AS relative_to_average
FROM store_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY sc.store_id;

WITH counts AS (

  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx

  JOIN trader AS tr

)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  analysed_trade_records,
  analysed_trade_records::numeric / SUM(analysed_trade_records) OVER () AS share_of_overall_total
FROM counts;

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_analyses
FROM advancedbehavior AS a
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
GROUP BY t.tradekind;

WITH station_averages AS (

  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct

  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandusagepct,
       s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS excess_overall_average

CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY excess_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT
  s.observstation,
  s.avg_bandusagepct,
  s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS above_overall_avg
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
shares AS (
    SELECT member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_counts
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(member_count) AS total_members,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM (
    SELECT mc.member_count, a.share, a.average_share
    FROM major_counts AS mc
    JOIN averaged AS a ON a.share = mc.member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member)
    WHERE a.share > a.average_share
) AS above_average;

WITH major_groups AS (
    SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
group_shares AS (
    SELECT member_count,
           CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_groups
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT member_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM group_shares
)
SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share

WITH nationality_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
    COUNT(*) AS constructor_entries
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT
  nationality,
  total_points,
  constructor_entries,
  constructor_entries - AVG(constructor_entries) OVER () AS entries_above_or_below_average
FROM nationality_totals;

WITH nationality_counts AS (
  SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr
    ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(result_record_count * 1.0) AS average_record_count
  FROM nationality_counts
), nationality_totals AS (
  SELECT c.nationality,
         SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
         COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr
    ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT nt.nationality,
       nt.total_points,
       nt.result_record_count,
       nt.result_record_count - oa.average_record_count AS difference_from_average
FROM nationality_totals AS nt
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
ORDER BY nt.nationality;

WITH category_averages AS (
    SELECT
        pc.product_type_description,
        AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_difference
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Products AS p
        ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
        ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
    GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
),
category_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS mean_average_difference
    FROM category_averages
),
above_mean AS (
    SELECT
        ca.average_quantity,
        ca.average_difference,
        ca.average_difference - cm.mean_average_difference AS excess_difference
    FROM category_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm
    WHERE ca.average_difference > cm.mean_average_difference
)
SELECT
    AVG(average_quantity) AS average_of_category_average_quantity,
    AVG(average_difference) AS average_of_category_average_difference,
    AVG(excess_difference) AS average_excess_over_category_mean
FROM above_mean;

WITH line_values AS (
    SELECT
        pc.product_type_description,
        CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS product_quantity,
        ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS cost_difference
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Products AS p
      ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
    JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
      ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
), category_averages AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_description,
        AVG(product_quantity) AS average_quantity,
        AVG(cost_difference) AS average_cost_difference
    FROM line_values
    GROUP BY product_type_description
), category_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference
    FROM category_averages
), qualifying_categories AS (
    SELECT ca.average_quantity, ca.average_cost_difference, cm.mean_cost_difference
    FROM category_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm
    WHERE ca.average_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference
)
SELECT
    AVG(average_quantity) AS average_of_qualifying_categories_average_quantity,
    AVG(average_cost_difference) AS average_of_qualifying_categories_average_cost_difference,
    AVG(average_cost_difference - mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess_cost_difference
FROM qualifying_categories

WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref, st.riskeval, s.pressratio
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
       avg_compression_ratio,
       scan_count,
       scan_count::numeric / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH grouped_scans AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si
    ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval
),
matched_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(scan_count) AS total_scans
  FROM grouped_scans
)
SELECT
  g.site_code,
  g.risk_evaluation_status,
  g.average_compression_ratio,
  g.scan_count,
  g.scan_count::numeric / t.total_scans AS share_of_matched_scans
FROM grouped_scans AS g
CROSS JOIN matched_total AS t
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg_price, o.overall_avg_price
  FROM type_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE o.overall_avg_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ta.type_avg_price > o.overall_avg_price
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) AS mean_type_avg_price
  FROM above_overall
), remaining AS (
  SELECT ao.type_avg_price, ao.overall_avg_price, km.mean_type_avg_price
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
  WHERE km.mean_type_avg_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ao.type_avg_price > km.mean_type_avg_price
)
SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(type_avg_price - overall_avg_price) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(type_avg_price - mean_type_avg_price) AS average_above_kept_mean
FROM remaining;

WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS average_unit_price
  FROM Products
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average_unit_price
  FROM Products
),
first_kept AS (
  SELECT t.production_type_code, t.average_unit_price, b.overall_average_unit_price
  FROM type_averages t
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE b.overall_average_unit_price IS NOT NULL
    AND t.average_unit_price > b.overall_average_unit_price
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) AS mean_kept_type_average
  FROM first_kept
),
remaining AS (
  SELECT f.average_unit_price, f.overall_average_unit_price, m.mean_kept_type_average
  FROM first_kept f
  CROSS JOIN first_mean m
  WHERE f.average_unit_price > m.mean_kept_type_average
)
SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(average_unit_price - overall_average_unit_price) AS average_above_overall_baseline,
       AVG(average_unit_price - mean_kept_type_average) AS average_above_mean_of_first_kept_types
FROM remaining;

WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signals
  FROM signals
)
SELECT tc.telescref,
       tc.signal_count,
       tc.signal_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_signals, 0) AS signal_fraction
FROM telescope_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY signal_fraction DESC, tc.telescref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS fraction
FROM signals
GROUP BY telescref
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '[missing]') AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '[missing]')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    mix_count,
    mix_count::numeric / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    mix_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  order_type_mix,
  mix_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY order_type_mix;

WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
), mix_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    transaction_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share
  FROM mix_shares
)
SELECT
  ordertypedist,
  transaction_count,
  share,
  share - baseline_share AS above_baseline_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > baseline_share;

WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_reference,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS size_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_minute_rate) AS average_project_rate
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT
  pr.project_reference,
  pr.funding_source,
  pr.size_per_minute_rate,
  pr.size_per_minute_rate - b.average_project_rate AS gap_above_benchmark
FROM project_rates AS pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE pr.size_per_minute_rate > b.average_project_rate
ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH project_groups AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_ref,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM project_groups
)
SELECT
  g.project_ref,
  g.funding_source,
  g.rate,
  g.rate - b.avg_rate AS excess
FROM project_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.avg_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT <> 0
    GROUP BY l.ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg
    FROM patient_ratios
), above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios AS p

    WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg
), group_avg AS (

), final_patients AS (

    CROSS JOIN group_avg AS g
    WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS average_amount_above_overall,
       AVG(above_group) AS average_amount_above_group
FROM final_patients;

WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL
       AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL
       AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg
    FROM patient_ratios
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, o.overall_avg,
           p.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios p
    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS kept_avg
    FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
    SELECT f.ratio, f.above_overall, f.ratio - s.kept_avg AS above_second
    FROM first_kept f
    CROSS JOIN second_avg s
    WHERE f.ratio > s.kept_avg
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS average_amount_above_overall,
       AVG(above_second) AS average_amount_above_second
FROM final_kept;

WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    avg_anlycount,
    avg_ownership_gap,
    AVG(avg_ownership_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT
  corpeventprx,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_ownership_gap,
  avg_ownership_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL;

WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_difference
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS avg_of_event_differences
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT
  e.corpeventprx,
  e.avg_anlycount,
  e.avg_ownership_difference,
  e.avg_ownership_difference - o.avg_of_event_differences AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM event_averages AS e
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.avg_of_event_differences IS NOT NULL;

WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS site_avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_faces) AS status_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), selected AS (
  SELECT sa.site_avg_faces, sta.status_avg_faces, oa.overall_avg_faces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.site_avg_faces > sta.status_avg_faces
    AND oa.overall_avg_faces IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) AS avg_face_count,
       AVG(site_avg_faces - overall_avg_faces) AS avg_above_overall,
       AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg_faces) AS avg_above_status
FROM selected;

WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
), kept AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_faces, b.avg_faces AS baseline_faces, sta.avg_faces AS status_faces
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN baseline AS b ON b.avg_faces IS NOT NULL
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  WHERE sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_faces
)
SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS average_kept_site_faces,
       AVG(avg_faces - baseline_faces) AS average_excess_overall_baseline,
       AVG(avg_faces - status_faces) AS average_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept;

WITH race_name_stats AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS field_size
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field_size
  FROM race_name_stats
)
SELECT AVG(rns.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points,
       AVG(rns.field_size) AS avg_field_size,
       AVG(rns.field_size - overall.avg_field_size) AS avg_above_overall_field_size
FROM race_name_stats AS rns
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE rns.field_size > overall.avg_field_size;

WITH per_name AS (
  SELECT r.name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_count
  FROM per_name
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_points),
       AVG(p.driver_count),
       AVG(p.driver_count - o.avg_count)
FROM per_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.driver_count > o.avg_count;

WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    a.translink,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    translink,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share
  FROM combination_counts
),
with_average_share AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_margin_over_average_share
FROM with_average_share
WHERE share > average_share
GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
pair_shares AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    tradekind,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share
  FROM pair_counts
),
scored_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    tradekind,
    record_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share
  FROM pair_shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_share
FROM scored_pairs
WHERE share > avg_share
GROUP BY tradekind

WITH college_player_counts AS (
    SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_player_counts
)
SELECT cpc.state,
       AVG(cpc.player_count) AS avg_college_player_count,
       AVG(cpc.player_count / o.avg_count) AS avg_count_relative_to_overall,
       AVG(cpc.player_count / o.total_count) AS avg_college_share_of_total
FROM college_player_counts AS cpc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
GROUP BY cpc.state;

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
), college_metrics AS (
    SELECT state,
           record_count,
           AVG(record_count) OVER () AS overall_average,
           SUM(record_count) OVER () AS overall_total
    FROM college_counts
)
SELECT state,
       AVG(record_count) AS average_college_count,
       AVG(record_count * 1.0 / overall_average) AS average_relative_count,
       AVG(record_count * 1.0 / overall_total) AS average_college_share
FROM college_metrics
GROUP BY state;

WITH region_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM region_shares
)
SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_clients,
       AVG(rs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(rs.share - av.share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM region_shares AS rs
CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
WHERE rs.share > av.share;

WITH region_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM region_shares
)
SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_client_count,
       AVG(rs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(rs.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM region_shares AS rs
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE rs.share > a.avg_share;

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_points_won,
    avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS distance_from_average
FROM country_averages;

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p
      ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_points_won,
    avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS distance_from_average_of_country_averages
FROM country_averages;

WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), shares AS (
  SELECT order_count,
         order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - overall_avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > overall_avg_share;

WITH order_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
type_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordertune,
    order_count,
    order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM order_type_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM type_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    tr.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON tx.transreg = s.transref
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg
  FROM pair_averages
), kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_anlycount,
         p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_pair_avg AS margin_over_mean
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_pair_avg
), type_averages AS (
  SELECT tradekind,
         AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(margin_over_mean) AS avg_margin_over_mean
  FROM kept_pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       avg_anlycount,
       avg_margin_over_mean,
       avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS relative_to_type_mean
FROM type_averages;

WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg
  FROM pair_averages
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.transref,
    p.tradekind,
    p.avg_anlycount,
    p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_pair_avg AS amount_above_mean
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_pair_avg
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(amount_above_mean) AS avg_amount_above_mean
  FROM kept_pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_amount_above_mean,
  avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_type_avg
FROM type_averages;

WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS overall_average
  FROM rating_rentals
)
SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS average_for_above_average_ratings,
       AVG(rr.rental_count - ra.overall_average) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM rating_rentals rr
CROSS JOIN rating_averages ra
WHERE rr.rental_count > ra.overall_average

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT AVG(rc.rental_count) AS average_count_above_overall,
       AVG(rc.rental_count - oa.avg_count) AS average_excess_overall
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE rc.rental_count > oa.avg_count

WITH invoice_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
        AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall AS (

), above_average AS (
    SELECT im.avg_product_cost, im.avg_ratio, o.overall_avg_ratio

    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE im.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
    AVG(avg_ratio - overall_avg_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio
FROM above_average

)
