FROM kept_invoices

WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    avg_unit_price,
    avg_bytes_per_ms,
    avg_bytes_per_ms - AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) OVER () AS above_all_album_avg
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, above_all_album_avg
FROM scored
ORDER BY above_all_album_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond_rate) AS average_rate_across_albums
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  ar.AlbumId,
  ar.average_unit_price,
  ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate,
  ar.bytes_per_millisecond_rate - o.average_rate_across_albums AS difference_above_average
FROM album_rates AS ar
CROSS JOIN overall_rate AS o
ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM actor a
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
  GROUP BY a.actor_id
), fractions AS (
  SELECT actor_id,
         film_count,
         film_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS fraction_of_total
  FROM actor_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT actor_id,
         film_count,
         fraction_of_total,
         fraction_of_total - AVG(fraction_of_total) OVER () AS difference_from_average
  FROM fractions
)
SELECT actor_id, film_count, fraction_of_total, difference_from_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
), actor_values AS (
  SELECT actor_id,
         film_count,
         film_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS credit_share
  FROM actor_counts
)
SELECT actor_id,
       film_count,
       credit_share,
       credit_share - AVG(credit_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM actor_values
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH linked_fees AS (
    SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg_rebate
    FROM linked_fees
), grouped AS (
    SELECT orderslink, ordertune,
           AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
           AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
    FROM linked_fees
    GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune AS order_type,
       g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap,
       g.avg_rebate - x.overall_avg_rebate AS above_overall_avg
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS x
WHERE g.avg_rebate > x.overall_avg_rebate
ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
), grouped AS (
  SELECT orderslink, ordertune,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
         AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
)
SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune AS order_type,
       g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap,
       g.avg_rebate - b.avg_rebate AS excess_over_baseline
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.avg_rebate
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_averages AS (
    SELECT
        r.circuitId,
        c.country,
        AVG(r.round) AS avg_round
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(avg_round) AS avg_round
    FROM circuit_averages
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
    ca.circuitId,
    ca.country,
    ca.avg_round AS circuit_avg_round,
    ca.avg_round - co.avg_round AS difference
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS co ON co.country = ca.country
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH circuit_averages AS (

  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_baselines AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(average_round) AS baseline

ORDER BY difference_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST

WITH equipment_avg AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference,
         AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
reference_avgs AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS all_equipment_average
  FROM equipment_avg
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ea.equipment_reference,
         ea.average_humidity,
         ra.all_equipment_average
  FROM equipment_avg ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_avgs ra
  WHERE ea.average_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.average_humidity > ra.all_equipment_average
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS above_average_group_mean
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.equipment_reference,
       aa.average_humidity,
       aa.average_humidity - aa.all_equipment_average AS above_all_equipment_average,
       aa.average_humidity - gm.above_average_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean gm
WHERE gm.above_average_group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST,
         aa.average_humidity DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
), reference_averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT ea.equipref,
           ea.avg_humidity,
           ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages ea
    CROSS JOIN reference_averages ra
    WHERE ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
      AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
), with_kept_mean AS (
    SELECT k.*,
           AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS kept_avg
    FROM kept k
)
SELECT equipref,
       avg_humidity,
       excess_humidity,
       avg_humidity - kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM with_kept_mean
WHERE kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, equipref
LIMIT 10;

WITH all_votes AS (
    SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max
    FROM player_award_vote
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_id, points_won, points_max
    FROM manager_award_vote
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.death_country, ''), '') AS country,
           AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS average_share
    FROM all_votes AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
      AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL
      AND v.points_max <> 0
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.death_country, ''), '')
)
SELECT country,
       average_share,
       average_share / AVG(average_share) OVER () AS relative_ratio
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY country

WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u
    ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
mean_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_avg
  FROM pair_averages
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    p.orderslink,
    p.acctscope,
    p.avg_fee_rate,
    p.avg_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN mean_average AS m
  WHERE p.avg_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    avg_fee_rate,
    excess,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY acctscope
      ORDER BY excess DESC
    ) AS scope_rank
  FROM above_mean
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  acctscope,
  avg_fee_rate,
  excess,
  scope_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE scope_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank, orderslink;

WITH award_winners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, p.bats
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS manager_count
    FROM award_winners
    GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT bats AS batting_hand,
       manager_count,
       CAST(manager_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share_of_winning_managers
FROM hand_counts;

WITH color_counts AS (
  SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
), overall AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_line_items
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
), per_color_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(line_item_count) AS average_count
  FROM color_counts
), qualifying_colors AS (
  SELECT cc.line_item_count,
         1.0 * cc.line_item_count / o.total_line_items AS share,
         cc.line_item_count - a.average_count AS excess
  FROM color_counts AS cc
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  CROSS JOIN per_color_average AS a
  WHERE cc.line_item_count > a.average_count
)
SELECT AVG(line_item_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess) AS average_excess
FROM qualifying_colors;

WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), store_averages AS (
  SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_totals
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.payment_total) AS sum_of_above_average_rental_totals,
       AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.avg_payment_total) AS avg_excess_over_store_average
FROM rental_totals rt
JOIN store_averages sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id
WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.avg_payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;

WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    ii.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ii.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS average_invoiced_quantity,
    AVG((ii.derived_product_cost - ii.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ii.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ii
  INNER JOIN Order_Items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = ii.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY ii.order_item_id, p.product_color
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    average_invoiced_quantity,
    average_cost_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color
      ORDER BY average_invoiced_quantity DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS quantity_rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  average_invoiced_quantity,
  average_cost_ratio,
  quantity_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE quantity_rank <= 3;

WITH regional AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), cross_region_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg
    FROM regional
), above_mean AS (
    SELECT r.avg_amount, r.transaction_count, m.mean_avg
    FROM regional AS r
    CROSS JOIN cross_region_mean AS m
    WHERE r.avg_amount > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_of_above_region_averages,
    AVG(transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count,
    AVG(avg_amount - mean_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_region_mean
FROM above_mean;

SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
  AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rental_price,
  AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) / (
    SELECT AVG(rating_avg_per_day)
    FROM (
      SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_avg_per_day
      FROM film
      GROUP BY rating
    ) AS rating_averages
  ) AS ratio_to_mean_rating_per_day_price
FROM film
GROUP BY rating

WITH album_stats AS (
    SELECT
        AlbumId,
        SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY AlbumId
), mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM album_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate,
    AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count,
    AVG(a.rate - m.rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM album_stats AS a
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m
WHERE a.rate > m.rate;

WITH per_event_name AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_name
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM per_event_name
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.avg_amount,
       p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall,
       p.avg_amount / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall
FROM per_event_name AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg;

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(spent) AS total_spent,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        total_spent / NULLIF(total_amount, 0) AS spend_ratio
    FROM event_totals
), ratios_with_average AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        spend_ratio,
        AVG(spend_ratio) OVER () AS overall_average
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT
    event_id,
    spend_ratio,
    spend_ratio / NULLIF(overall_average, 0) AS relative_spend_ratio
FROM ratios_with_average
ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH StateCounts AS (
    SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY BillingState
), GroupStats AS (
    SELECT InvoiceCount,
           CAST(InvoiceCount AS REAL) / SUM(InvoiceCount) OVER () AS Share,
           AVG(CAST(InvoiceCount AS REAL)) OVER () AS AverageCount
    FROM StateCounts
)
SELECT SUM(InvoiceCount) AS TotalInvoices,
       AVG(Share) AS AverageShare,
       AVG(InvoiceCount - AverageCount) AS AverageExcessCount
FROM GroupStats
WHERE InvoiceCount > AverageCount;

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
), invoice_deviations AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price,
           avg_unit_price - AVG(avg_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation,
           AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_avg_deviation
    FROM invoice_deviations
)
SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation,
       deviation - country_avg_deviation AS deviation_minus_country_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT powerstatus,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH gender_counts AS (
    SELECT c.gender,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Invoices AS i
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
), gender_shares AS (
    SELECT gender,
           order_count,
           1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM gender_counts
), shares_with_average AS (
    SELECT gender,
           order_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM gender_shares
)
SELECT gender,
       order_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares_with_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate,
         sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_first,
         fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS fk
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

WITH account_region AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
                ELSE 0
            END) AS account_sum,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
), region_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(account_sum) AS region_total
    FROM account_region
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    ar.account_id,
    ar.region,
    ar.account_sum,
    ar.transaction_count,
    ar.account_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(rt.region_total, 0) AS share
FROM account_region AS ar
JOIN region_totals AS rt ON rt.region = ar.region
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_order_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
kept AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM per_timespan
  WHERE distinct_order_count > (
    SELECT AVG(distinct_order_count)
    FROM per_timespan
  )
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_group_avg_ratios,
  SUM(distinct_order_count) AS sum_distinct_order_counts,
  AVG(distinct_order_count - (
    SELECT AVG(distinct_order_count)
    FROM per_timespan
  )) AS avg_excess_count
FROM kept

WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country
),
all_country_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins
  FROM country_averages
),
above_all AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, m.mean_wins AS all_mean
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN all_country_mean AS m
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > m.mean_wins
),
above_all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins
  FROM above_all
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_wins, aa.all_mean, m.mean_wins AS above_all_mean
  FROM above_all AS aa
  CROSS JOIN above_all_mean AS m
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > m.mean_wins
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_final_average_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - all_mean) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean,
  AVG(avg_wins - above_all_mean) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean
FROM final_countries;

WITH rep_counts AS (
    SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
    FROM Customer AS c
    JOIN Employee AS e
      ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
    GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
city_averages AS (
    SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS average_count
    FROM rep_counts
    GROUP BY City
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.customer_count, a.average_count
    FROM rep_counts AS r
    JOIN city_averages AS a
      ON r.City = a.City OR (r.City IS NULL AND a.City IS NULL)
    WHERE r.customer_count > a.average_count
),
all_kept AS (
    SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.City,
       SUM(aa.customer_count) AS total_customers,
       AVG(aa.customer_count - aa.average_count) AS average_excess,
       AVG(1.0 * aa.customer_count / ak.total_customers) AS average_share
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN all_kept AS ak
GROUP BY aa.City;

WITH matched_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg AS transaction_reference,
    tr.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
    sf.shortintrt,
    sf.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
), transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    transaction_reference,
    order_type_mix,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest,
    AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY transaction_reference, order_type_mix
), mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS baseline_short_interest
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY order_type_mix
)
SELECT
  ta.transaction_reference,
  ta.order_type_mix,
  ta.avg_short_interest,
  ta.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(mb.baseline_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio_to_baseline
FROM transaction_averages AS ta
JOIN mix_baselines AS mb
  ON mb.order_type_mix IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ta.order_type_mix
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio_to_baseline DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
           COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total
    FROM line_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT lt.total_cost, lt.expense_count, oa.average_total
    FROM line_totals AS lt
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE lt.total_cost > oa.average_total
)
SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_of_totals,
       SUM(expense_count) AS total_expense_count,
       AVG(total_cost - average_total) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

SELECT
  t.MediaTypeId,
  AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageTrackUnitPrice,
  AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS RatioToOverallAverage
FROM Track AS t
GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY RatioToOverallAverage DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM fielding AS f
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(player_count) AS average_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT h.batting_hand,
       h.player_count,
       1.0 * h.player_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total,
       h.player_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts AS h
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE h.player_count > t.average_count

WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
), metrics AS (
  SELECT city_id,
         address_count,
         address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS relative_to_avg,
         address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS address_share
  FROM city_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT city_id, address_count, relative_to_avg, address_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_share DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM metrics
)
SELECT city_id, address_count, relative_to_avg, address_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY address_share DESC, city_id;

WITH operator_rates AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    SUM(scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE scancount IS NOT NULL
     OR (gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0)
  GROUP BY crewref
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM operator_rates
  WHERE avg_gb_per_minute > (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) FROM operator_rates)
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_scans) AS avg_total_scans,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_minute - (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) FROM operator_rates)) AS avg_margin_above_all_operator_average
FROM qualified;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       appearance_count,
       appearance_count * 1.0 / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       appearance_count * 1.0 / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM hand_counts;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
)
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp,
       AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount,
       AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM matched) AS imgcount_avg_minus_overall
FROM matched
GROUP BY entrystat;

WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate
  FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  mr.media_type_name,
  mr.byte_rate,
  mr.byte_rate - oa.average_rate AS above_average
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE mr.byte_rate > oa.average_rate;

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM station_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
  FROM shares
), eligible AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scored
  WHERE above_average > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY above_average DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY above_average DESC;

WITH project_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux,
    SUM(ss.boxx) AS total_boxx,
    SUM(ss.boxz) AS total_boxz
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    arcregistry,
    fundflux,
    total_boxx / NULLIF(total_boxz, 0) AS ratio
  FROM project_totals
), project_excess AS (
  SELECT
    arcregistry,
    fundflux,
    ratio,
    ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS excess
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, excess
FROM project_excess
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), kept AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
), kept_results AS (
  SELECT res.laps
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN kept AS k ON k.name = r.name
  WHERE res.laps IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM kept) AS sum_kept_total_points,
  (SELECT AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) FROM kept_results) AS avg_laps,
  (SELECT AVG(total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) FROM kept) AS avg_excess_over_average;

WITH site_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_record_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m
    ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_metrics
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT sm.*, sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_metrics AS sm
  JOIN status_averages AS sa USING (insurstat)
  WHERE sm.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT
  insurstat,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_site_ratio,
  SUM(mesh_record_count) AS total_mesh_records,
  AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        P.ID,
        P.SEX,
        AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS alb_tp_avg,
        AVG(L.APTT - L.PT) AS aptt_pt_avg
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
    GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(alb_tp_avg) AS alb_tp_avg,
        AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS aptt_pt_avg
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
),
threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(aptt_pt_avg) AS mean_aptt_pt_avg
    FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(S.alb_tp_avg) AS avg_alb_minus_tp,
    AVG(S.aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt,
    AVG(S.aptt_pt_avg - T.mean_aptt_pt_avg) AS avg_excess_over_sex_mean
FROM sex_averages AS S
CROSS JOIN threshold AS T
WHERE S.aptt_pt_avg > T.mean_aptt_pt_avg

WITH account_volumes AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_transactions
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    region,
    total_volume,
    number_of_transactions,
    total_volume * 1.0 / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS share_of_total_volume
FROM account_volumes
ORDER BY share_of_total_volume DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.gender,
           COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Customers AS c
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender
), shares AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           gender,
           order_count,
           CAST(order_count AS DECIMAL(38, 18))
               / SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS share
    FROM customer_orders
), gaps AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           gender,
           order_count,
           share,
           share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT customer_id,
       gender,
       order_count,
       share,
       above_average
FROM gaps
WHERE above_average > 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN above_average IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total
  FROM scanfeatures
),
shares AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         s.artifact_count,
         s.artifact_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.artifact_total, 0) AS share
  FROM site_totals AS s
  CROSS JOIN overall_total AS t
  WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         artifact_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT zoneref,
       artifact_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM averaged
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    constructorId,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM constructorStandings
  GROUP BY constructorId
),
counts_with_average AS (
  SELECT
    constructorId,
    record_count,
    AVG(record_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT
  c.constructorId,
  c.nationality,
  cca.record_count,
  cca.record_count - cca.average_count AS difference_from_average
FROM counts_with_average AS cca
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cca.constructorId
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price
  FROM rating_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(rm.avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths,
  AVG(rm.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price,
  AVG(rm.per_day_price - crm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price
FROM rating_metrics AS rm
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean AS crm
WHERE rm.per_day_price > crm.mean_per_day_price

WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_avg_got
  FROM Laboratory
), patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc,
       p.avg_got - o.overall_avg_got AS got_difference
FROM patient_avgs AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg_got IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY got_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH district_client_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM disp AS dp
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
)
SELECT
    region,
    AVG(client_count) AS average_district_client_count,
    AVG(1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) AS average_district_share
FROM district_client_counts
GROUP BY region;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS manager_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
shares AS (
    SELECT throws, manager_count,
           1.0 * manager_count / SUM(manager_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT throws, manager_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(manager_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH team_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games
    FROM home_game
    GROUP BY team_id
), ratios AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        total_home_games,
        total_home_games * 1.0 / SUM(total_home_games) OVER () AS fraction_of_all,
        total_home_games * 1.0 / AVG(total_home_games) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
    FROM team_totals
)
SELECT team_id, total_home_games, fraction_of_all, ratio_to_average
FROM ratios
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH group_rates AS (
    SELECT
        s.riskeval,
        AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate
    FROM scans AS sc
    JOIN sites AS s
      ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
    GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM group_rates
),
above_benchmark AS (
    SELECT gr.rate, b.avg_rate
    FROM group_rates AS gr
    CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
    WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate
)
SELECT
    AVG(rate) AS average_rate,
    AVG(rate - avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        account_count,
        1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM district_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        account_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference
    FROM shares
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS position
    FROM scored
)
SELECT district_id, account_count, share, difference
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= 10
ORDER BY difference DESC;

WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN disp AS p
      ON p.account_id = o.account_id
     AND p.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
      ON c.client_id = p.client_id
    JOIN district AS d
      ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), account_differences AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference_from_overall_average
    FROM account_order_counts
), regional_differences AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        difference_from_overall_average,
        difference_from_overall_average
          - AVG(difference_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY region)
            AS excess_over_region_average
    FROM account_differences
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    region,
    order_count,
    difference_from_overall_average,
    excess_over_region_average
FROM regional_differences
WHERE excess_over_region_average > 0
ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(avg_remaining) AS average_remaining,
        AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate
    FROM event_metrics
    GROUP BY status
),
all_events_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_event_avg_remaining
    FROM event_metrics
)
SELECT
    sm.status,
    sm.average_remaining,
    sm.average_overspend_rate,
    sm.average_remaining / NULLIF(aem.mean_event_avg_remaining, 0) AS average_remaining_divided_by_all_events_mean
FROM status_metrics AS sm
CROSS JOIN all_events_mean AS aem;

WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT
        b.link_to_event AS event_id,
        AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_avg_spending_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e
      ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE b.spent <> 0
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
), type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        e.type,
        AVG(er.event_avg_spending_rate) AS average_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates AS er
    JOIN event AS e
      ON e.event_id = er.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT
    type,
    average_spending_rate,
    average_spending_rate / NULLIF(AVG(average_spending_rate) OVER (), 0) AS rate_divided_by_simple_mean
FROM type_rates;

WITH counts_by_type AS (
    SELECT
        t.tradekind,
        COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
    FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
      ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
    JOIN trader AS t
      ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        tradekind,
        analysis_count,
        analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM counts_by_type
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(analysis_count) AS avg_count
    FROM counts_by_type
)
SELECT
    SUM(s.analysis_count) AS sum_counts,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.analysis_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.analysis_count > a.avg_count;

WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           AVG(amount) AS average_amount,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       average_amount,
       transaction_count,
       transaction_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) FROM account_stats) AS ratio
FROM account_stats
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH channel_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT
  orderbase AS channel,
  avg_filled_quantity,
  distinct_order_count,
  distinct_order_count::numeric
    / NULLIF(SUM(distinct_order_count) OVER (), 0) AS order_count_fraction
FROM channel_counts;

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_group_avg
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    g.ID,
    g.avg_ana,
    g.avg_ana - o.mean_group_avg AS excess
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE g.avg_ana > o.mean_group_avg
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), fractions AS (
    SELECT ID,
           examination_count,
           1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction
    FROM group_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID,
           examination_count,
           fraction,
           fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () AS excess
    FROM fractions
)
SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, excess
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM matched
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY mktnote
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.benchmark_rate AS excess
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess) AS average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH channel_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN fees AS f ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM channel_averages
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT ca.avg_fee_rate, ca.avg_fee_rate - b.benchmark_rate AS excess_rate
  FROM channel_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE ca.avg_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_avg_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess_rate) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN client AS c
        ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        client_count,
        SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_client_count,
        SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_client_count
    FROM district_counts
)
SELECT
    district_id,
    region,
    client_count,
    1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(region_client_count, 0) AS share_of_region,
    1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(overall_client_count, 0) AS share_of_overall
FROM with_totals
ORDER BY share_of_overall DESC, district_id
LIMIT 10

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_shares AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_count,
         rental_count / SUM(rental_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM rating_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM rating_shares
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS overall_average
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT AVG(sc.player_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(sc.player_count - o.overall_average) AS average_excess
FROM state_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE sc.player_count > o.overall_average;

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall_avg
    FROM patient_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_avg
    FROM patient_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_kept_avg
    FROM kept
)
SELECT k.ID,
       k.avg_hgb,
       k.avg_hgb - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       k.avg_hgb - m.mean_kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_total,
  order_count::numeric / NULLIF(AVG(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_scope_average
FROM scope_counts;

WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), above_average AS (
    SELECT account_id, order_count
    FROM account_order_counts
    WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_order_counts)
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    order_count,
    order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_order_counts) AS above_overall_average,
    order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM above_average) AS above_kept_average
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    archstat,
    project_count,
    project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT
  archstat,
  project_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();

WITH matched_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderflow, e.fillcount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
), status_counts AS (
  SELECT orderflow, AVG(NULLIF(fillcount, 0)) AS avg_filled_quantity,
         COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM matched_executions
  GROUP BY orderflow
)
SELECT orderflow, avg_filled_quantity, execution_count,
       execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS execution_fraction
FROM status_counts;

WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS group_amount FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT group_amount, 1.0 * group_amount / SUM(group_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_totals), compared AS (SELECT group_amount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(group_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

WITH per_frequency AS (
    SELECT
        a.frequency,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.frequency
),
frequency_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_amount
    FROM per_frequency
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(p.avg_balance) AS avg_balance,
    AVG(p.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_amount) AS avg_excess
FROM per_frequency AS p
CROSS JOIN frequency_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_amount

WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), execution_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS benchmark
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_unfilled, oa.avg_unfilled - em.benchmark AS excess_first
  FROM order_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN execution_mean em
  WHERE oa.avg_unfilled > em.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark
  FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_unfilled, fk.excess_first,
         fk.avg_unfilled - sb.benchmark AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept fk
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb
  WHERE fk.avg_unfilled > sb.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS average_of_remaining_averages,
       AVG(excess_first) AS average_excess_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(excess_second) AS average_excess_over_second_benchmark
FROM remaining;

WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
shares AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         account_count,
         1.0 * account_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share
  FROM district_counts
)
SELECT district_id, account_count, share
FROM shares
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH observatory_shares AS (
    SELECT
        observstation,
        COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
        100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_pct
    FROM telescopes
    GROUP BY observstation
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT
        observatory_shares.*,
        AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct
    FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes,
    AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
    AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM averaged
WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;

WITH major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_major AS major_id,
        COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        member_count,
        CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction
    FROM major_member_counts
)
SELECT major_id, member_count, fraction
FROM ranked
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
all_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(ps.avg_pic) AS avg_of_patient_avg_pic,
    AVG(ps.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(ps.ratio - apa.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess
FROM patient_stats AS ps
CROSS JOIN all_patient_average AS apa
WHERE ps.ratio > apa.avg_ratio;

SELECT NULLIF(c.state, '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS fraction_of_all_records
FROM player_college AS pc
JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
GROUP BY NULLIF(c.state, '')

WITH case_averages AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS baseline_avg
  FROM compliancecase
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT ca.brokrepstat, ca.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg
  FROM case_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ca.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg
), reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_mean
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.brokrepstat AS status,
       q.avg_modelconf,
       q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS avg_minus_baseline,
       q.avg_modelconf / r.qualifying_mean AS avg_divided_by_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN reference r
WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND r.qualifying_mean IS NOT NULL;

WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
), rates_with_average AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(byte_rate) OVER () AS cross_media_type_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price,
       AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate,
       AVG(byte_rate - cross_media_type_avg_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate
FROM rates_with_average
WHERE byte_rate > cross_media_type_avg_rate;

WITH rates AS (
  SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name,
         AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT Name, rate,
       rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS relative_rate
FROM rates;

WITH film_actor_counts AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
), first_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actor_count
  FROM film_actor_counts
), first_selected AS (
  SELECT c.film_id, c.actor_count, c.actor_count - a.avg_actor_count AS excess_first
  FROM film_actor_counts c
  CROSS JOIN first_average a
  WHERE a.avg_actor_count IS NOT NULL
    AND c.actor_count > a.avg_actor_count
), second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_actor_count
  FROM first_selected
), second_selected AS (
  SELECT s.actor_count, s.excess_first,
         s.actor_count - a.avg_actor_count AS excess_second
  FROM first_selected s
  CROSS JOIN second_average a
  WHERE a.avg_actor_count IS NOT NULL
    AND s.actor_count > a.avg_actor_count
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actor_count), 0) AS total_actor_count,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_average,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_average
FROM second_selected

WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT a.link_to_member AS member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position
), shares AS (
    SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM member_attendance
), ranked AS (
    SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank
    FROM shares
)
SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC;

SELECT
  circuitId,
  AVG(round) AS average_round,
  COUNT(*) AS race_count,
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS race_share
FROM races
GROUP BY circuitId
ORDER BY race_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_ratio
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_spent_ratio,
       avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_mean_of_type_averages
FROM per_type;

WITH type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name AS media_type_name,
        SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
mean_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate
    FROM type_rates
)
SELECT
    tr.media_type_name,
    tr.rate,
    tr.track_count,
    tr.rate - mr.mean_rate AS rate_above_mean
FROM type_rates AS tr
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS mr
WHERE tr.rate > mr.mean_rate;

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), above_average AS (
  SELECT film_count,
         AVG(film_count) OVER () AS across_rating_avg
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT SUM(film_count) AS total_films,
       AVG(film_count - across_rating_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average
WHERE film_count > across_rating_avg;

WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    sr.*,
    AVG(sr.avg_rate) OVER () AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_rates AS sr
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate_of_selected_statuses,
  AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scan_count,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate
FROM with_overall
WHERE avg_rate > overall_avg_rate;

WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_record_count
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> ''
  GROUP BY p.SEX
), above_average AS (
  SELECT sex, test_record_count,
         AVG(test_record_count) OVER () AS per_group_average
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT sex,
       test_record_count,
       CAST(test_record_count AS REAL) / SUM(test_record_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       test_record_count - per_group_average AS above_average_by
FROM above_average
WHERE test_record_count > per_group_average;

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), ranked AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM station_counts
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC;

WITH counts_by_side AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts_by_side
)
SELECT
  SUM(c.risk_margin_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(c.risk_margin_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM counts_by_side AS c
CROSS JOIN average_count AS a
WHERE c.risk_margin_count > a.avg_count;

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(t.amount) AS account_avg
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_avg) AS region_avg
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        region_avg,
        AVG(region_avg) OVER () AS all_region_avg
    FROM region_averages
),
above_regions AS (
    SELECT region, region_avg, all_region_avg
    FROM region_stats
    WHERE region_avg > all_region_avg
)
SELECT
    region,
    region_avg AS figure,
    region_avg - all_region_avg AS excess,
    region_avg / AVG(region_avg) OVER () AS ratio_to_above_average_mean
FROM above_regions;

SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS conservation_record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS status_share
FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.insurstat;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
), shares AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           player_count,
           1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), with_average AS (
    SELECT batting_hand,
           player_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT batting_hand,
       player_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average
FROM with_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count,
           SUM(record_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT cc.record_count,
           o.avg_count,
           o.total_count
    FROM college_counts AS cc
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE cc.record_count > o.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(record_count * 1.0 / total_count) AS average_share_of_total,
       AVG(record_count - avg_count) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM above_average;

WITH invoices_per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoices
    GROUP BY order_id
), shares AS (
    SELECT order_id, invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM invoices_per_order
), above_average AS (
    SELECT invoice_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_number_of_invoices,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_transaction_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(avg_transaction_amount) AS avg_account_transaction_amount,
        AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    avg_account_transaction_amount,
    avg_account_balance,
    avg_account_transaction_amount /
        NULLIF(AVG(avg_account_transaction_amount) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_overall_region_mean
FROM region_averages;

WITH per_player AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.bats,
        AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason AS bp
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
), indexed AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        avg_doubles,
        avg_doubles / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx
    FROM per_player
), compared AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        avg_doubles,
        idx,
        idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference
    FROM indexed
    WHERE bats IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index, difference
FROM compared
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS account_avg
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
  GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    frequency,
    account_avg,
    account_avg / AVG(account_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio
  FROM per_account
)
SELECT account_id, frequency, account_avg, ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         AVG((sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
         AVG(sp.aream2 / sp.volm3) AS area_to_volume_figure
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS sp ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), with_cross_source_avg AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(area_to_volume_figure) OVER () AS cross_source_avg
  FROM per_source
)
SELECT fundflux,
       avg_y_vs_x_difference,
       area_to_volume_figure,
       area_to_volume_figure - cross_source_avg AS above_cross_source_avg
FROM with_cross_source_avg
WHERE area_to_volume_figure > cross_source_avg;

WITH per_status AS (
    SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status,
       attendance_count,
       1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS proportion
FROM per_status;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
), shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         site_count,
         site_count::numeric / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT site_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(site_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH item_quantities AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS quantity
  FROM Order_Items
),
order_averages AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM item_quantities
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS baseline_avg
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT
  oa.order_id,
  oa.avg_quantity,
  oa.avg_quantity - b.baseline_avg AS difference
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    t.observstation,
    t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
), station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
), phase_averages AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM station_averages
  GROUP BY lunarstage
), phase_counts AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  c.lunarstage,
  a.avg_bandusagepct,
  c.telescope_count,
  c.telescope_count::DECIMAL / SUM(c.telescope_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total
FROM phase_counts AS c
JOIN phase_averages AS a
  ON a.lunarstage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.lunarstage;

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), account_differences AS (
    SELECT
        oc.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        oc.order_count,
        oc.order_count - AVG(oc.order_count) OVER () AS difference
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference
FROM account_differences
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS baseline_length
  FROM rating_averages
), above_baseline AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length, b.baseline_length
  FROM rating_averages ra
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ra.avg_length > b.baseline_length
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length
  FROM above_baseline
), remaining AS (
  SELECT ab.avg_length, ab.baseline_length, km.mean_length
  FROM above_baseline ab
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
  WHERE ab.avg_length > km.mean_length
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_avg_length,
       AVG(avg_length - baseline_length) AS mean_excess_over_baseline,
       AVG(avg_length - mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean
FROM remaining

SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), per_town AS (
  SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS average_price, AVG(avg_cost_ratio) AS average_ratio
  FROM per_item
  GROUP BY town_city
), with_baseline AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS cross_town_average_ratio
  FROM per_town
)
SELECT town_city, average_price, average_ratio,
       average_ratio - cross_town_average_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM with_baseline
WHERE average_ratio > cross_town_average_ratio;

WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM per_media_type
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT p.byte_rate, p.track_count, o.overall_avg_rate
  FROM per_media_type AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE p.byte_rate > o.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(byte_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM above_average;

WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
), shares AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo,
         employee_count,
         1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM group_counts
)
SELECT ReportsTo,
       employee_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT tradekind,
         transaction_count,
         SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT tradekind,
       transaction_count,
       transaction_count::numeric / total_count AS share_of_total,
       transaction_count - average_count AS count_minus_average
FROM stats
WHERE transaction_count > average_count;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    COUNT(*) AS conservation_records,
    COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_matched
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_records, fraction_of_matched
FROM grouped
ORDER BY fraction_of_matched DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate) / NULLIF(AVG(rental_duration), 0) AS per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day
  FROM per_rating
), above_average AS (
  SELECT p.per_day, o.avg_per_day
  FROM per_rating p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.per_day > o.avg_per_day
)
SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_average_ratings,
       AVG(per_day - avg_per_day) AS avg_excess_over_rating_average
FROM above_average

WITH counts_per_type AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), type_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts_per_type
), above_average AS (
  SELECT c.order_count, a.avg_count
  FROM counts_per_type AS c
  CROSS JOIN type_average AS a
  WHERE c.order_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(order_count - avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
), above_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS baseline
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  avg_modindex - baseline AS above_baseline,
  avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM above_baseline
WHERE avg_modindex > baseline
ORDER BY rfistat;

WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
), execution_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    oa.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_execution_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN order_averages AS oa
    ON oe.ordersmark = oa.ordersmark
  GROUP BY oa.timespan
), ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.timespan,
    oa.avg_fill,
    oa.avg_fill - eb.avg_execution_fill AS excess_fill,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY oa.timespan
      ORDER BY oa.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_averages AS oa
  JOIN execution_baselines AS eb
    ON oa.timespan = eb.timespan
  WHERE oa.avg_fill > eb.avg_execution_fill
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  excess_fill,
  fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3;

WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
), hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throws, player_count,
           1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT throws, player_count, share
    FROM hand_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
), group_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        member_count,
        CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_members,
        CAST(member_count AS REAL) / AVG(member_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
    FROM member_counts
)
SELECT major_id, member_count, fraction_of_members, ratio_to_average
FROM group_metrics
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH SexAverages AS (
    SELECT
        p.SEX,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
        AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    avg_acl_igg,
    avg_ana,
    avg_ana / NULLIF(AVG(avg_ana) OVER (), 0) AS relative_avg_ana
FROM SexAverages;

WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), shares AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share
  FROM circuit_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT circuitId,
         race_count,
         share,
         share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY excess_share DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH prior_round AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.round,
         (SELECT p.raceId
          FROM races p
          WHERE p.year = r.year AND p.round < r.round
          ORDER BY p.round DESC
          LIMIT 1) AS priorRaceId
  FROM races r
), gains AS (
  SELECT pr.raceId, c.country,
         ds.wins - CASE
           WHEN pr.priorRaceId IS NULL THEN 0
           ELSE prev.wins
         END AS wins_gained
  FROM prior_round pr
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = (
    SELECT r.circuitId FROM races r WHERE r.raceId = pr.raceId
  )
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = pr.raceId
  LEFT JOIN driverStandings prev
    ON prev.raceId = pr.priorRaceId AND prev.driverId = ds.driverId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
), race_averages AS (
  SELECT country, raceId, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins_gained
  FROM gains
  GROUP BY country, raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS avg_wins_gained
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS overall_benchmark
  FROM country_averages
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins_gained, b.overall_benchmark
  FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE ca.avg_wins_gained > b.overall_benchmark
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS mean_above_benchmark
  FROM above_benchmark
)
SELECT ab.country,
       ab.avg_wins_gained AS average,
       ab.avg_wins_gained - ab.overall_benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark,
       ab.avg_wins_gained - sm.mean_above_benchmark AS above_second_mean
FROM above_benchmark ab
CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
WHERE ab.avg_wins_gained > sm.mean_above_benchmark;

WITH unit_ownership AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.instownpct) AS ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
units_with_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    ownership,
    AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_baseline,
    AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average
  FROM unit_ownership
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT ownership, mix_baseline, overall_average
  FROM units_with_baselines
  WHERE ownership > overall_average
)
SELECT
  AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership,
  AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline_ratio,
  AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM kept_units;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS order_reference,
    o.orderflow AS status,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    status,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share
  FROM counts
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    status,
    record_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share_minus_status_average
  FROM shares
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_status_average DESC) AS difference_rank
  FROM compared
  WHERE share_minus_status_average > 0
)
SELECT
  order_reference,
  status,
  record_count,
  share,
  share_minus_status_average
FROM ranked
WHERE difference_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_status_average DESC;

WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member AS mem
    JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.department
), shares AS (
    SELECT department, member_count,
           1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
), average_share AS (
