    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT s.department,
       s.member_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share >= a.avg_share;

WITH invoices_per_gender AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoices AS i
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.gender
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count
    FROM invoices_per_gender
)
SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count_above_overall,
       AVG(g.invoice_count - a.avg_invoice_count) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM invoices_per_gender AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
WHERE g.invoice_count > a.avg_invoice_count;

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_film_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_film_ratio,
  film_count,
  avg_film_ratio - AVG(avg_film_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_rating_average
FROM rating_averages;

WITH funding_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(*) AS qc_record_count
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  qc_record_count,
  qc_record_count::numeric / SUM(qc_record_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
  qc_record_count::numeric / AVG(qc_record_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
FROM funding_counts;

WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT ta.telescref,
       ta.avg_modindex,
       ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg_modindex AS above_overall_average,
       ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_avg_modindex AS ratio_to_overall_average
FROM telescope_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg_modindex
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS baseline_avg
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
combination_averages AS (
    SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref
    JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
combination_deviations AS (
    SELECT ca.transref, ca.tradekind, ca.avg_optvolrt,
           ca.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_avg AS deviation
    FROM combination_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation
    FROM combination_deviations
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
    SELECT cd.tradekind, cd.avg_optvolrt, cd.deviation,
           cd.deviation - ta.avg_deviation AS excess
    FROM combination_deviations AS cd
    JOIN type_averages AS ta ON ta.tradekind = cd.tradekind
    WHERE cd.deviation > ta.avg_deviation
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT
    status_rates.*,
    AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) OVER () AS average_rate_across_statuses
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
  healtheval,
  total_scancount,
  gb_per_minute_rate,
  gb_per_minute_rate - average_rate_across_statuses AS rate_minus_average
FROM with_average
WHERE gb_per_minute_rate > average_rate_across_statuses;

WITH film_copy_counts AS (
  SELECT i.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id, f.rating
), deviations AS (
  SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count,
         copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS rating_avg_difference,
         copy_count - AVG(copy_count) OVER () AS overall_avg_difference
  FROM film_copy_counts
)
SELECT film_id, rating, copy_count, rating_avg_difference, overall_avg_difference
FROM deviations
ORDER BY overall_avg_difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS SIGNED)), 0) AS units
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    units,
    units / NULLIF(SUM(units) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM product_units
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    units,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share
  FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(units) AS combined_units,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > overall_average_share

WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    behavior_count,
    behavior_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(behavior_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM type_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    behavior_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  behavior_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL
  AND share > average_share;

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_order_net_fee_rate
  FROM per_order
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_rebtotal, p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.mean_order_net_fee_rate
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.mean_order_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS average_total_rebate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - mean_order_net_fee_rate) AS average_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH staff_totals AS (
  SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM payment p
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.staff_id
)
SELECT staff_id,
       total_amount,
       total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_combined_total
FROM staff_totals;

WITH project_counts AS (
    SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
    FROM scanqc
    GROUP BY arcref
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_count,
        qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share,
        qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER ()
            - AVG(qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER ()) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM project_counts
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_count,
        share,
        deviation,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC) AS deviation_rank
    FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM ranked
WHERE deviation_rank <= 10
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH linked_signals AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg, o.weathprofile
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM linked_signals
), telescope_weather AS (
  SELECT telescref, weathprofile,
         AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex,
         AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM linked_signals AS l
  JOIN signals AS s ON s.signalregistry = l.signalregistry
  GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile
), kept_groups AS (
  SELECT tw.*
  FROM telescope_weather AS tw
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex
)
SELECT weathprofile,
       AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
       AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
       AVG(avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
GROUP BY weathprofile;

WITH sex_averages AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT <> 0
    GROUP BY p.SEX
), first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM sex_averages
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_ratio, f.mean_ratio AS first_mean
    FROM sex_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f
    WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.mean_ratio
), second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
    SELECT k.avg_ratio, k.first_mean, m.mean_ratio AS second_mean
    FROM first_kept AS k
    CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
    WHERE k.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_remaining_group_ratio,
       AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a
      ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
), regional_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS regional_average
    FROM district_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        regional_average,
        account_count - regional_average AS excess_count
    FROM regional_comparison
    WHERE account_count > regional_average
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        region,
        account_count,
        excess_count,
        CAST(account_count AS REAL) /
            AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess_count, ratio
FROM scored
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH per_scope AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  avg_net_rate,
  fee_record_count,
  avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_average
FROM per_scope;

WITH bucket_counts AS (
    SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM riskandmargin AS r
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
    GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
    SELECT record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM bucket_counts
), kept AS (
    SELECT share
    FROM shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM bucket_counts WHERE record_count::numeric / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM bucket_counts) > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)), 0) AS total_count,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess
FROM kept;

WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct
  FROM observatory_counts
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct,
       AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_share_pct
FROM averaged
WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;

WITH state_totals AS (
    SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS state_total
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT state_county_province,
           state_total,
           state_total / SUM(state_total) OVER () AS share
    FROM state_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT state_total, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(state_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

WITH rating_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(rm.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
  AVG(rm.daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
  AVG(rm.daily_price - cra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price
FROM rating_metrics AS rm
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_avg AS cra
WHERE rm.daily_price > cra.avg_daily_price

WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM Customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT account_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM state_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM state_shares
), above_average AS (
    SELECT sc.account_count, ss.share, av.avg_share
    FROM state_counts AS sc
    JOIN state_shares AS ss ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
    WHERE ss.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(account_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

WITH country_counts AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
), country_shares AS (
    SELECT birth_country, player_count,
           CAST(player_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS player_share
    FROM country_counts
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS average_player_count
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT SUM(cs.player_count) AS total_player_count,
       AVG(cs.player_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.player_count - oa.average_player_count) AS average_excess_over_average
FROM country_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE cs.player_count > oa.average_player_count;

WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT city_id, address_count,
         address_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_count DESC) AS count_rank
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT city_id, address_count, fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE count_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC, city_id;

WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, trd.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS trd
    ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, trd.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, behavior_count,
         behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS count_share
  FROM pair_counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(behavior_count) AS average_count_per_pair,
       AVG(count_share) AS average_share_per_pair
FROM shares
GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_minus_igm
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_overall_mean AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_pt,
        avg_iga_minus_igm,
        AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) OVER () AS overall_mean
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS average_patient_avg_pt,
    AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) AS average_patient_avg_iga_minus_igm,
    AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm / overall_mean) AS average_ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM with_overall_mean
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH qualifying_counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_record_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY driverId
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT 1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) / COUNT(*) AS avg_records_per_driver
  FROM drivers
)
SELECT qc.driverId,
       qc.qualifying_record_count,
       1.0 * qc.qualifying_record_count / oa.avg_records_per_driver AS ratio
FROM qualifying_counts AS qc
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
ORDER BY ratio DESC, qc.driverId
LIMIT 10;

WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p."fundflux", COUNT(*) AS spatial_record_count
  FROM "scanspatial" AS ss
  JOIN "projects" AS p ON p."arcregistry" = ss."arcref"
  GROUP BY p."fundflux"
), stats AS (
  SELECT "fundflux", spatial_record_count,
         SUM(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS total_count,
         AVG(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT "fundflux",
       spatial_record_count AS count,
       spatial_record_count::numeric / total_count AS share,
       spatial_record_count - average_count AS excess_over_average
FROM stats
WHERE spatial_record_count > average_count;

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_account_avg
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT aa.account_id,
       aa.avg_amount,
       aa.avg_amount - om.mean_account_avg AS above_mean
FROM account_averages AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE aa.avg_amount > om.mean_account_avg
ORDER BY above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.college,
       SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount,
       CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) /
           (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_all_income
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member
JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
GROUP BY m.college;

WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
    SELECT record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM group_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
), kept AS (
    SELECT gc.record_count,
           gc.record_count * 1.0 / SUM(gc.record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM group_counts AS gc
)
SELECT AVG(kept.record_count) AS average_record_count,
       AVG(kept.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(kept.share - average_share.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM kept
CROSS JOIN average_share
WHERE kept.share > average_share.avg_share;

WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
    AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
  ia.invoice_number,
  ia.average_quantity,
  ia.average_cost_ratio,
  ia.average_quantity - oa.average_quantity AS quantity_above_average
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_quantity > oa.average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id
    JOIN major AS m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.department
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT department, income_count,
           1.0 * income_count / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT department, income_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
)
SELECT SUM(income_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share)
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share

WITH per_order AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
    FROM orderexecutions
    GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_stage AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        avg_fill,
        avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS first_excess
    FROM per_order
), second_stage AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        avg_fill,
        first_excess
    FROM first_stage
    WHERE first_excess > 0
), final_stage AS (
    SELECT
        avg_fill,
        first_excess,
        avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS second_excess
    FROM second_stage
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_per_order_fill_quantity,
    AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess,
    AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess
FROM final_stage
WHERE second_excess > 0;

WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS combined_count,
         AVG(1.0 * patient_count) AS average_count
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT SUM(s.patient_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(1.0 * s.patient_count / t.combined_count) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.patient_count - t.average_count) AS average_excess
FROM sex_counts AS s
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE s.patient_count > t.average_count;

SELECT i.film_id, COUNT(*) AS copy_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_all_copies
FROM inventory AS i
GROUP BY i.film_id
ORDER BY share_of_all_copies DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT timespan,
         risk_margin_record_count,
         risk_margin_record_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan,
       risk_margin_record_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY timespan;

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
), shares AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           order_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`), 0) AS share
    FROM order_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
), above_average AS (
    SELECT s.share, av.avg_share
    FROM shares AS s
    CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
    WHERE s.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(oc.order_count)
                 FROM order_counts AS oc
                 JOIN above_average AS aa ON aa.share = oc.order_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`), 0)), 0) AS total_orders,
       AVG(aa.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(aa.share - aa.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average AS aa

WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        pc.product_type_description,
        AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS order_item_count
    FROM Products AS p
    JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
      ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_description,
        average_quantity,
        order_item_count,
        CAST(order_item_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))
          / SUM(order_item_count) OVER () AS order_item_share
    FROM product_metrics
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_description,
        AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity,
        AVG(order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
        AVG(order_item_share) AS average_order_item_share
    FROM product_shares
    GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
    AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity,
    AVG(average_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
    AVG(average_order_item_share) AS average_share
FROM type_averages

WITH invoice_costs AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_cost_sum,
        SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost_sum,
        COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        product_cost_sum / NULLIF(total_cost_sum, 0) AS cost_ratio,
        line_item_count
    FROM invoice_costs
), ratios_with_average AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        cost_ratio,
        line_item_count,
        AVG(cost_ratio) OVER () AS average_cost_ratio
    FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    cost_ratio,
    line_item_count,
    cost_ratio / NULLIF(average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM ratios_with_average
WHERE average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent) AS average_spent,
    AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining,
    AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_excess_over_mean
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event
ORDER BY remaining_excess_over_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu
  FROM scanprocessing AS sp
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    ga.*,
    AVG(ga.avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS mean_group_avg_storage
  FROM group_avgs AS ga
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  insurance_status,
  avg_remaining_storage,
  avg_cpu_minus_gpu,
  avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(mean_group_avg_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_group_avg_storage IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.location,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        location,
        average_ratio,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY location
            ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS event_rank
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT event_id, location, average_ratio, event_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE event_rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, event_rank, event_id;

WITH per_currency AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(NULLIF(rebtotal, 0)) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN rebrate <> 0 AND feerate <> 0
        THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate
      END
    ) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_rebtotal, p.avg_relative_gap, b.mean_avg_rebtotal
  FROM per_currency AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_rebtotal > b.mean_avg_rebtotal
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
  AVG(avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_rebate_to_fee_gap,
  AVG(avg_rebtotal - mean_avg_rebtotal) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;

WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS baseline_avg
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL
), status_avgs AS (
    SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS status_avg
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY event_status
)
SELECT s.event_status AS status,
       s.status_avg AS average,
       s.status_avg - b.baseline_avg AS average_minus_baseline
FROM status_avgs AS s
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL;

WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM transaction_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg
  FROM transaction_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg
), kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept
)
SELECT k.transref,
       k.avg_anlycount,
       k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg
FROM kept k
CROSS JOIN kept_average ka
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId
  )
  GROUP BY c.location
), shares AS (
  SELECT city, race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT city, race_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT city, race_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb,
        AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb,
        AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        SEX,
        avg_alb,
        avg_un_tbil_ratio,
        AVG(avg_alb) OVER () AS mean_sex_avg_alb
    FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    avg_alb,
    avg_un_tbil_ratio,
    avg_alb - mean_sex_avg_alb AS alb_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE avg_alb > mean_sex_avg_alb;

WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg
  FROM phase_stats
),
kept_phases AS (
  SELECT p.avg_bandusage, p.station_count, m.mean_phase_avg
  FROM phase_stats AS p
  CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_phase_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_bandusage) AS kept_phases_avg_bandusage,
  SUM(station_count) AS total_distinct_station_counts,
  AVG(avg_bandusage - mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess_over_phase_mean
FROM kept_phases;

WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) AS average_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
  country,
  average_points,
  average_wins,
  average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS average_wins_minus_country_mean
FROM country_averages;

WITH account_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        c.town_city,
        COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM Accounts AS a
    JOIN Customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft
        ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> ''
    GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
), town_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        town_city,
        transaction_count,
        SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_transaction_total,
        AVG(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_average_per_account
    FROM account_counts
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    town_city,
    transaction_count,
    1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(town_transaction_total, 0) AS share_of_town_transactions,
    1.0 * transaction_count / NULLIF(town_average_per_account, 0) AS ratio_to_town_average
FROM town_stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_town_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
        AVG(l.HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(l.HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_wbc,
        ratio,
        AVG(ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT
    ID AS patient_id,
    SEX AS sex,
    avg_wbc AS average_wbc,
    ratio,
    ratio - overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_overall_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE ratio > overall_mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_overall_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH club_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members
    FROM member
), major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.major_id,
        m.department,
        COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member AS mb
    JOIN major AS m
      ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
), major_shares AS (
    SELECT
        mc.major_id,
        mc.department,
        mc.member_count,
        CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(cs.total_members, 0) AS share
    FROM major_counts AS mc
    CROSS JOIN club_size AS cs
), ranked_shares AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        department,
        member_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_average
    FROM major_shares
)
SELECT
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    share,
    share - department_average AS above_department_average
FROM ranked_shares
WHERE share > department_average
ORDER BY above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_station_bandusage
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT AVG(sa.avg_bandusage) AS mean_above_baseline_station_average,
       AVG(sa.avg_bandusage - b.avg_station_bandusage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM station_averages sa
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE sa.avg_bandusage > b.avg_station_bandusage;

WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS baseline
  FROM signals
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate, fb.baseline AS first_baseline
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline fb
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > fb.baseline
),
second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS baseline
  FROM above_first
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT af.avg_pulse_rate, af.first_baseline, sb.baseline AS second_baseline
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline sb
  WHERE af.avg_pulse_rate > sb.baseline
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate - first_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline,
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate - second_baseline) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline
FROM final_telescopes;

WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), shares AS (
    SELECT event_id,
           attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / NULLIF(SUM(attendance_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM per_event
), ranked AS (
    SELECT event_id,
           attendance_count,
           share,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank
    FROM shares
)
SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH per_reference AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(execution_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM per_reference
), deviations AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
  FROM shares
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST) AS place
  FROM deviations
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM ranked
WHERE place <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
  FROM Customer c
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), customer_shares AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerId,
    total_spent,
    total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM customer_totals
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    total_spent,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_spent) AS average_total_spent,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG((share - average_share) / NULLIF(average_share, 0)) AS average_relative_difference
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH site_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.traitcount), 0) AS feature_count
  FROM sites AS s
  LEFT JOIN scanfeatures AS f
    ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
   AND f.traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry
),
site_shares AS (
  SELECT
    zoneregistry,
    feature_count,
    feature_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM site_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    zoneregistry,
    feature_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM site_shares
)
SELECT
  zoneregistry AS site_code,
  feature_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS margin_above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT observstation,
       telescope_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10;

WITH race_stats AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        c.country,
        COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count,
        SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        race_stats.*,
        AVG(entry_count) OVER () AS average_entry_count,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY entry_count DESC) AS entry_count_rank
    FROM race_stats
)
SELECT
    raceId,
    country,
    total_points,
    entry_count,
    entry_count - average_entry_count AS above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE entry_count > average_entry_count
  AND entry_count_rank <= 10
ORDER BY above_average DESC;

WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_relative_overspend,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
per_category_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count
    FROM category_stats
),
qualifying_categories AS (
    SELECT cs.avg_relative_overspend, cs.line_count, p.avg_line_count
    FROM category_stats AS cs
    CROSS JOIN per_category_average AS p
    WHERE cs.line_count > p.avg_line_count
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend,
    AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count,
    AVG(1.0 * line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count
FROM qualifying_categories;

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id,
       order_count,
       CAST(order_count AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders), 0) AS order_share
FROM customer_order_counts
ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        SUM(w) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins,
        AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT *,
           AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    avg_wins,
    avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss,
    avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean
FROM eligible
WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip
    GROUP BY z.city
),
city_shares AS (
    SELECT city, member_count,
           1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT member_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(member_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
), deviations AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm,
           acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM per_patient
), sex_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS sex_avg_deviation
    FROM deviations
), ranked AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - sex_avg_deviation AS excess,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY (deviation - sex_avg_deviation) IS NULL,
                        deviation - sex_avg_deviation DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM sex_averages
    WHERE deviation > sex_avg_deviation
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation, excess
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY (excess IS NULL), excess DESC;

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_group_avg
    FROM group_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_acl_igg, o.mean_group_avg
    FROM group_averages AS g
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE g.avg_acl_igg > o.mean_group_avg
)
SELECT pattern,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_acl_igg - mean_group_avg AS above_mean,
       avg_acl_igg - AVG(avg_acl_igg) OVER () AS from_kept_mean
FROM kept;

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
),
kept_events AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.avg_amount, oa.avg_amount AS overall_avg
    FROM event_averages AS ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.avg_amount
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    avg_amount,
    avg_amount - overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
    avg_amount - AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS above_kept_events_average
FROM kept_events
ORDER BY above_kept_events_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
),
source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS project_count
  FROM project_ratios
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
source_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(project_count) AS avg_project_count
  FROM source_stats
),
kept_sources AS (
  SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.project_count, a.avg_project_count
  FROM source_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN source_average AS a
  WHERE s.project_count > a.avg_project_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(project_count) AS total_distinct_projects,
  AVG(project_count - avg_project_count) AS avg_excess_project_count
FROM kept_sources

WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.player_id,
        p.death_country,
        SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL
      AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
), above_average AS (
    SELECT player_id, death_country, total
    FROM player_totals
    WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM player_totals)
)
SELECT
    SUM(total) AS sum_of_totals,
    AVG(total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM player_totals)) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_instownpct) AS mean_group_average,
       AVG(g.avg_instownpct - b.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM group_avgs AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.avg_instownpct > b.overall_avg;

WITH store_counts AS (
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
  FROM customer
  WHERE active = 1
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  active_customer_count,
  active_customer_count / SUM(active_customer_count) OVER () AS share_of_active_customers,
  active_customer_count / AVG(active_customer_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average_store_count
FROM store_counts
ORDER BY store_id;

WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_analysed_transactions
FROM per_type;

WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusagepct,
       s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS above_overall_avg
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_major
), shares AS (
    SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT member_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(member_count), 0) AS total_members,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

WITH constructor_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT
  nationality,
  total_points,
  constructor_count,
  constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_totals;

WITH category_averages AS (
  SELECT
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_difference
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p
    ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
), category_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference
  FROM category_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_category_quantity,
  AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference) AS average_category_cost_difference,
  AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference - cm.mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess_cost_difference
FROM category_averages AS ca
CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm
WHERE ca.avg_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference;

WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, si.riskeval, sc.pressratio
  FROM scans AS sc
  INNER JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
), shares AS (
  SELECT zoneregistry, COUNT(*) AS matched_scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneregistry
), ranked AS (
  SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code,
         g.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
         g.avg_pressratio,
         g.scan_count,
         g.scan_count::numeric / SUM(g.scan_count) OVER () AS scan_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY g.scan_count::numeric / SUM(g.scan_count) OVER () DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM grouped AS g
)
SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_share
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY scan_share DESC;

WITH type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price
    FROM Products
    WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY production_type_code
), baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS baseline_price
    FROM type_averages
), above_baseline AS (
    SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price, b.baseline_price
    FROM type_averages t
    CROSS JOIN baseline b
    WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL
      AND t.avg_price > b.baseline_price
), kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_price
    FROM above_baseline
), remaining AS (
    SELECT a.avg_price, a.baseline_price, m.mean_price
    FROM above_baseline a
    CROSS JOIN kept_mean m
    WHERE m.mean_price IS NOT NULL
      AND a.avg_price > m.mean_price
)
SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(avg_price - baseline_price) AS average_above_baseline,
       AVG(avg_price - mean_price) AS average_above_kept_types_mean
FROM remaining;

WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), ranked AS (
  SELECT telescref, signal_count,
         signal_count::numeric / SUM(signal_count) OVER () AS fraction,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count::numeric / SUM(signal_count) OVER () DESC) AS fraction_rank
  FROM telescope_counts
)
SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction
FROM ranked
WHERE fraction_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC;

WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded') AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded')
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    behavior_count,
    behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    behavior_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  order_type_mix,
  behavior_count,
  share,
  share - baseline_average_share AS above_baseline_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > baseline_average_share;

WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_reference,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE s.gbsize / s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_group_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  g.project_reference,
  g.funding_source,
  g.rate,
  g.rate - b.avg_group_rate AS excess
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.avg_group_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_patient AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(1.0 * HGB / HCT) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
  GROUP BY ID
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_patient
), first_group AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ratio, o.overall_avg,
         p.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
  FROM per_patient p CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS group_avg
  FROM first_group
), final_group AS (
  SELECT f.avg_ratio, f.above_overall,
         f.avg_ratio - s.group_avg AS above_second
  FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN second_avg s
  WHERE f.avg_ratio > s.group_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS average_amount_above_overall,
       AVG(above_second) AS average_amount_above_second
FROM final_group;

WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_ownership_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_abs_ownership_diff) AS avg_of_event_differences
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT
  e.corpeventprx,
  e.avg_anlycount,
  e.avg_abs_ownership_diff,
  e.avg_abs_ownership_diff - o.avg_of_event_differences AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM event_averages AS e
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE o.avg_of_event_differences IS NOT NULL;

WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh AS m
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_site_faces
  FROM site_averages
  WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY entrystat
), kept_sites AS (
  SELECT sa.avg_faces, oa.avg_faces AS overall_avg, sta.avg_site_faces AS status_avg
  FROM site_averages AS sa
  JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline AS oa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    AND oa.avg_faces IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_site_faces
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_faces) AS average_kept_site_faces,
  AVG(avg_faces - overall_avg) AS average_excess_overall_baseline,
  AVG(avg_faces - status_avg) AS average_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept_sites;

WITH race_name_stats AS (
  SELECT r.name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS standings_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(standings_count) AS avg_count
  FROM race_name_stats
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_points),
       AVG(s.standings_count),
       AVG(s.standings_count - o.avg_count)
FROM race_name_stats AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.standings_count > o.avg_count;

WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind AS trader_type,
    a.translink,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink
), pair_shares AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    translink,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS share
  FROM pair_counts
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    translink,
    record_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS average_share
  FROM pair_shares
)
SELECT
  trader_type,
  AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM pair_averages
WHERE share >= average_share
GROUP BY trader_type;

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.college_id,
        c.state,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college AS pc
    JOIN college AS c
      ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
), overall AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(player_count) AS avg_count,
        SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_counts
)
SELECT
    cc.state,
    AVG(cc.player_count) AS avg_college_player_count,
    AVG(cc.player_count / o.avg_count) AS avg_relative_to_overall_college_average,
    AVG(cc.player_count / o.total_count) AS avg_college_share_of_total
FROM college_counts AS cc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
GROUP BY cc.state
ORDER BY cc.state;

WITH client_account_links AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id, dist.A3 AS region
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district AS dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
), region_counts AS (
    SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client_account_links
    GROUP BY region
), region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
), summary AS (
    SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(share) AS average_share,
           AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_shares)) AS average_excess_share
    FROM region_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_shares)
)
SELECT total_count, average_share, average_excess_share
FROM summary;

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.death_country,
        AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT
    death_country,
    avg_points_won,
    avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_average_of_group_averages
FROM group_averages;

WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), above_average AS (SELECT execution_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS summed_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average WHERE share > overall_average_share;

WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT
        s.transref,
        tr.tradekind AS trader_type,
        AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
        ON tx.transreg = s.transref
    JOIN trader AS tr
        ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
    GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_pair_avg
    FROM pair_averages
), kept_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        p.trader_type,
        p.avg_anlycount,
        p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_pair_avg AS amount_above_mean
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
    WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_pair_avg
), type_averages AS (
    SELECT
        trader_type,
        AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs,
        AVG(amount_above_mean) AS avg_amount_above_mean
    FROM kept_pairs
    GROUP BY trader_type
)
SELECT
    trader_type,
    avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs,
    avg_amount_above_mean,
    avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs
        / AVG(avg_anlycount_of_kept_pairs) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_across_trader_types
FROM type_averages;

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS rented_films
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rented_films) AS avg_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT AVG(rc.rented_films) AS average_count,
       AVG(rc.rented_films - o.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.rented_films > o.avg_count

WITH invoice_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
        SUM(derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS total_cost_to_price_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost_to_price_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT
    AVG(im.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
    AVG(im.total_cost_to_price_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(im.total_cost_to_price_ratio - oa.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM invoice_metrics im
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE im.total_cost_to_price_ratio > oa.avg_ratio;

WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
average_album_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate
  FROM album_rates
),
track_groups AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
         SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT g.AlbumId,
       g.average_unit_price,
       g.bytes_per_millisecond,
       g.bytes_per_millisecond - a.average_rate AS rate_above_average
FROM track_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN average_album_rate AS a
ORDER BY rate_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
film_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_film_count
  FROM film_actor
),
actor_values AS (
  SELECT ac.actor_id,
         ac.film_count,
         ac.film_count / ft.distinct_film_count AS film_share
  FROM actor_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN film_total ft
)
SELECT actor_id,
       film_count,
       film_share,
       film_share - AVG(film_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM actor_values
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink AS orderslink,
    o.ordertune AS order_type,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) AS average_rebate,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rebate) AS average_group_rebate
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  g.orderslink,
  g.order_type,
  g.average_rebate,
  g.average_relative_gap,
  g.average_rebate - b.average_group_rebate AS excess_over_baseline
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.average_rebate > b.average_group_rebate
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_averages AS (
    SELECT
        r.circuitId,
        c.country,
        AVG(r.round) AS average_round
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        AVG(r.round) AS baseline_round
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    ca.circuitId,
    ca.country,
    ca.average_round,
    ca.average_round - co.baseline_round AS difference_from_country_baseline
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS co ON ca.country = co.country
ORDER BY difference_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept
), results AS (
  SELECT k.equipref,
         k.avg_humidity,
         k.avg_humidity - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
         k.avg_humidity - km.kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
  FROM kept k
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
  WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND km.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, above_overall_avg, difference_from_kept_mean
FROM results
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;

WITH vote_ratios AS (
    SELECT p.death_country AS country,
           1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0) AS ratio
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
    FROM vote_ratios
    WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       average_ratio,
       average_ratio / AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS relative_to_country_mean
FROM country_averages;

WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink AS orderslink,
    u.acctscope AS account_scope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
mean_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_fee_rate
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    p.orderslink,
    p.account_scope,
    p.average_fee_rate,
    p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_fee_rate AS excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.account_scope
      ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_fee_rate DESC, p.orderslink ASC
    ) AS rank
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN mean_average AS m
  WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_fee_rate
)
SELECT orderslink, account_scope, average_fee_rate, excess, rank
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY account_scope, rank;
